Suraton ke awwal mein Ha-Mim waghera jaise jo huroof aaye hain un ki poori behas Surah Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein kar aaye hain jis ke iaada ki ab chandan zaroorat nahin. Baaz kehte hain Ha-Mim Allah ka ek naam hai aur is ki shahadat mein woh yeh sher pesh karte hain: Yuzakkiruni Ha-Mim wal-rumhu shajirun, fahala tala Ha-Mim qablal-taqaddumi. Ya'ni yeh mujhe Ha-Mim yaad dilata hai jab ke neza tan chuka phir is se pehle hi us ne Ha-Mim kyun na keh diya. Abu Dawood aur Tirmidhi ki hadith mein warid hai ke agar tum par shab-khoon mara jaye to Ha-Mim la yunsarun kehna, is ki sanad sahih hai. Abu Ubaid kehte hain mujhe yeh pasand hai ke is hadith ko yun riwayat ki jaye ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tum kaho Ha-Mim la yunsaru ya'ni noon ke baghair, to goya un ke nazdeek la yunsaru jaza hai fa-qulu ki ya'ni jab tum yeh kaho ge tum maghloob nahin ho ge. To qaul sirf Ha-Mim raha. Yeh Kitab ya'ni Quran-e-Majeed Allah Ta'ala ki janib se nazil shuda hai jo izzat-o-ilm wala hai, jis ki janab har be-adabi se pak hai aur jis par koi zarra bhi makhfi nahin go woh kitne hi pardon mein ho, woh gunahon ki bakhshish karne wala aur jo us ki taraf jhuke us ki janib mail hone wala hai. Aur jo us se be-parwahi kare us ke samne sarkashi aur takabbur kare aur duniya ko pasand kar ke aakhirat se be-raghbat ho jaye. Allah ki farmanbardari ko chhod de use woh sakht tareen azab aur badtareen sazayein dene wala hai. Jaise farman hai (Nabbii 'ibadi anni anal-ghafurur-rahim 15. Al-Hijr: 49) ya'ni mere bandon ko aagah kar do ke main bakhshne wala aur meherbaniyan karne wala bhi hoon aur mere azab bhi bade dardnak azab hain. Aur bhi is qisam ki aayatein Quran-e-Karim mein bahut si hain jin mein rahm-o-karam ke sath azab-o-saza ka bayan bhi hai taake banda khauf-o-umeed ki halat mein rahe. Woh wus'at-o-ghina wala hai. Woh bahut behtari wala hai bade ehsano, zabardast nematon aur rehmaton wala hai. Bandon par us ke in'am, ehsan is qadar hain ke koi unhein shumar bhi nahin kar sakta che ja'ike us ka shukr ada kar sake. Balkeh haqeeqat yeh hai ke kisi ek nemat ka bhi poora shukr kisi se ada nahin ho sakta. Is jaisa koi nahin is ki ek sifat bhi kisi mein nahin is ke siwa koi ibadat ke laiq nahin na us ke siwa koi kisi ki parwarish karne wala hai. Isi ki taraf sab ko laut kar jana hai. Us waqt woh har amal karne wale ko us ke amal ke mutabiq jaza saza de ga. Aur bahut jald hisab se farigh ho jaye ga. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) se ek shakhs aa kar masla poochta hai ke main ne kisi ko qatl kar diya hai kya meri tauba qabool ho sakti hai? Aap ne shuru surat ki do aayatein tilawat farmayein aur farmaya na-umeed na ho aur nek amal kiye ja. (Ibn Abi Hatim) Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke paas ek shami kabhi kabhi aaya karta tha aur tha zara aisa hi aadmi ek martaba lambi muddat tak woh aaya hi nahin to Amir-ul-Momineen ne logon se us ka haal poocha unhon ne kaha ke us ne ba-kasrat sharab peena shuru kar diya hai.

Hazrat Umar R.A ne apne katib ko bulwa kar kaha likho yeh khat hai Umar bin Khattab ki taraf se falan bin falan ki taraf, ba'ad az salam-e-alaik mein tumhare samne us Allah ki tareefain karta hoon jis ke sath koi mabood nahin, jo gunahon ko bakhshne wala, tauba ko qabool karne wala, sakht azab wala, bade ehsan wala hai, jis ke siwa koi Allah nahin. Usi ki taraf lautna hai. Yeh khat us ki taraf bhijwa kar aap ne apne sathiyon se farmaya apne bhai ke liye dua karo ke Allah Ta'ala us ke dil ko mutawajja kar de aur us ki tauba qabool farmaye. Jab us shakhs ko Hazrat Umar R.A ka khat mila to us ne ise baar baar padhna aur yeh kehna shuru kiya ke Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe apni saza se daraya bhi hai aur apni rahmat ki umeed dila kar gunahon ki bakhshish ka wada bhi kiya hai, kai kai martaba ise padh kar ro diye, phir tauba ki aur sachi pakki tauba ki. Jab Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ko yeh pata chala to aap bahut khush hue aur farmaya isi tarah kiya karo. Jab tum dekho ke koi musalman bhai laghzish kha gaya to use seedha karo aur mazboot karo aur us ke liye Allah se dua karo. Shaitan ke madadgar na bano. Hazrat Sabit Bunani R.H farmate hain ke main Hazrat Mus'ab bin Zubair R.A ke sath Koofe ke gird-o-nawah mein tha, main ne ek bagh mein ja kar do rakat namaz shuru ki aur is Surah Momin ki tilawat karne laga, main abhi "Ilaihil Masir" tak pahuncha hi tha ke ek shakhs ne jo mere peeche safed khachar par sawar tha jis par Yamani chadarein thin mujh se kaha jab "Ghafiriz Zanb" padho to kaho "Ya Ghafiraz Zanbi Ighfirli Zanbi" aur jab "Qabilit Taub" padho to kaho "Ya Shadidal 'Iqabi La Tu'aqibni". Hazrat Mus'ab farmate hain main ne goshe chashm se dekha to mujhe koi nazar na aaya, farigh ho kar main darwaze par pahuncha wahan jo log baithe the un mein se main ne poocha ke kya koi shakhs tumhare paas se guzra jis par Yamani chadarein thin? Unhon ne kaha nahin hum ne to kisi ko aate jaate nahin dekha. Ab log yeh khayal karne lage ke yeh Hazrat Ilyas A.S the. Yeh riwayat dusri sanad se bhi marwi hai aur is mein Hazrat Ilyas A.S ka zikr nahin. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam.

Anbiya ki takzeeb kafiron ka shewa hai. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke haq ke zahir ho chukne ke baad use na manna aur is mein nuqsanat paida karne ki koshish karna kafiron ka hi kaam hai. Yeh log agar maal-dar aur zi-izzat hon to tum kisi dhoke mein na pad jana ke agar yeh Allah ke nazdeek bure hote to Allah inhe apni yeh ne'matein kyun ata farmata? Jaise aur jagah hai kafiron ka shehron mein chalna phirna tujhe dhoke mein na dale yeh to kuch yunhi sa faida hai aakhri anjam to un ka jahannam hai jo badtareen jagah hai. Ek aur ayat mein irshad hai hum inhe bahut kam faida de rahe hain bil-aakhir inhe sakht azab ki taraf be-bas kar denge. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tasalli deta hai ke logon ki takzeeb ki wajah se ghabrayein nahin. Apne se agle anbiya ke halaat ko dekhein ke inhe bhi jhutlaya gaya aur un par iman lane walon ki bhi bahut kam tadaad thi, Hazrat Nuh (A.S / Alaihis Salam) jo Bani Adam mein sab se pehle rasool ho kar aaye inhe un ki ummat jhutlati rahi balkeh sab ne apne apne zamane ke nabi ko qaid karna aur maar dalna chaha. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai main ne in batil walon ko pakad liya. Aur un ke in zabardast gunahon aur badtareen sarkashiyon ki bina par inhe halak kar diya. Ab tum hi batlao ke mere azab un par kaise kuch hue? Yani bahut sakht nihayat takleef-deh aur alamnak, jis tarah un par un ke is napak amal ki wajah se mere azab utar pade isi tarah ab is ummat mein se jo is aakhri Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki takzeeb karte hain un par bhi mere aise hi azab nazil hone wale hain. Yeh go nabiyon ko sacha manein lekin jab teri nabuwwat ke hi qail na hon un ki sachai mardood hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Yani bahut sakht nihayat takleef-deh aur alamnak, jis tarah un par un ke is napak amal ki wajah se mere azab utar pade isi tarah ab is ummat mein se jo is aakhri Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki takzeeb karte hain un par bhi mere aise hi azab nazil hone wale hain. Yeh go nabiyon ko sacha manein lekin jab teri nabuwwat ke hi qail na hon un ki sachai mardood hai. Wallahu A'lam.

Allah ki buzurgi aur paki bayan karne par mamoor farishtay. Arsh ko uthane wale farishtay aur us ke aas paas ke tamam behtareen buzurg farishtay ek taraf toh Allah ki paki bayan karte hain, tamam uyub aur kul kamiyon aur buraiyon se usay door batate hain, dusri janib usay tamam sataishon aur tareefon ke qabil maan kar us ki hamd baja late hain. Gharz jo Allah mein nahin us ka inkar karte hain aur jo sifatain us mein hain unhein sabit karte hain. Is par iman-o-yaqeen rakhte hain. Is se pasti aur aajizi zahir karte hain aur kul imandar mardon auraton ke liye istighfar karte rehte hain. Chunki zameen walon ka iman Allah Ta'ala par usay dekhe baghair tha. Is liye Allah Ta'ala ne apne muqarrab farishtay un gunahon ki maafi talab karne ke liye muqarrar kar diye jo un ke bin dekhe har waqt un ki taqseeron ki maafi talab kiya karte hain, Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai ke jab musalman apne musalman bhai ke liye us ki ghair haziri mein dua karta hai toh farishta us ki dua par aameen kehta hai aur us ke liye dua karta hai ke Allah tujhe bhi yahi de jo tu is musalman ke liye Allah se maang raha hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Umayyah bin Salt ke baaz ashaar ki Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tasdeeq ki jaise yeh sher hai: Zuhal-o-Saur taht-o-jal yameenuha, wal-nasru lil-ukhra wa laisun marsadu. Ya'ni hamilan-e-Arsh chaar farishtay hain, do ek taraf do dusri taraf. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya sach hai. Phir us ne kaha: Wal-shamsu tatlu'u kulla aakhiri lailatin, hamra'a yusbihu launuha yatawarradu, ta'bi fama tatlu'u lana fi rusliha, illa mu'azzabatan wa la tajalladu. Ya'ni suraj surkh rang tulu hota hai phir gulabi ho jata hai, apni hai'at mein kabhi saaf zahir nahin hota balkay rookha pheeka hi rehta hai, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya sach hai. Is ki sanad bahut pukhta hai aur is se saaf zahir hota hai ke is waqt hamilan-e-Arsh chaar farishtay hain, haan Qayamat ke din Arsh ko aath farishtay uthayenge. Jaise Quran Majeed mein hai (Wa yahmilu arsha rabbika fauqahum yauma'izin samaniyah) (Surah Al-Haqqah: 17). Haan is aayat ke matlab aur is hadith ke istidlal mein ek sawal reh jata hai ke Abu Dawood ki ek hadith mein hai ke Batha mein Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne sahaba ki ek jamaat se ek abr ko guzarte hue dekh kar sawal kiya ke is ka kya naam hai? Unhon ne kaha sahab. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya aur isay muzan bhi kehte hain? Kaha haan! Farmaya 'anan bhi? Arz kiya haan! Pucha jaante ho aasman-o-zameen mein kis qadar fasla hai? Sahaba ne kaha nahin, farmaya ikhattar ya behattar ya tehattar saal ka rasta, phir us ke upar ka aasman bhi pehle aasman se itne hi fasle par, isi tarah saton aasman, satwein aasman par ek samundar hai jis ki utni hi gehrai hai, phir us par aath farishtay pahari bakron ki surat ke hain jin ke khur se ghutne ka fasla bhi utna hi hai, un ki pusht par Allah Ta'ala ka Arsh hai jis ki unchai bhi isi qadar hai. Phir us ke upar Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala hai. Tirmidhi mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur Imam Tirmidhi isay ghareeb batate hain. Is se maloom hota hai ke Arsh-e-Allah is waqt aath farishton ke upar hai.

Hazrat Shahr bin Haushab R.H ka farman hai ke hamilan-e-Arsh aath hain jin mein se chaar ki tasbeeh toh yeh hai (Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika lakal-hamdu 'ala hilmika ba'da 'ilmika) yani aye Bari Ta'ala teri paak zaat hi ke liye har tarah ki hamd-o-sana hai ke tu bawajood ilm ke phir bardbari aur hilm karta hai. Aur dusre chaar ki tasbeeh yeh hai (Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika lakal-hamdu 'ala 'afwika ba'da qudratika) yani aye Allah bawajood qudrat ke tu jo ma'afi aur dargarzar karta rehta hai us par hum teri pakeezgi aur teri tareef bayan karte hain. Isi liye mominon ke istighfar mein woh yeh bhi kehte hain ke Allah teri rahmat-o-ilm ne har cheez ko apni wus'at-o-kushadgi mein le liya hai. Bani Adam ke tamam gunah un ki kul khataon par teri rahmat chaye hue hai, isi tarah tera ilm bhi un ke jumla aqwal-o-af'al ko apne andar liye hue hai. Un ki kul harkat-o-sakanat se tu bakhoobi waqif hai. Pas tu un ke bure logon ko jab woh tauba karein aur teri taraf jhukein aur gunahon se baaz aajayein aur tere ahkam ki tameel karein nekiyan karein badiyan chhorein bakhsh de, aur unhein jahannam ke dardnak ghabrahat wale azabon se nijat de. Unhein ma' un ke walidain biwiyon aur bachon ke jannat mein le ja taake un ki aankhein har tarah thandi rahein. Go un ke a'mal un jitne na hon taham tu un ke darajat barha kar unche darje mein pahuncha de. Jaise Bari Ta'ala ka farman-e-alishan hai (Wallazina amanu wattaba'athum zurriyyatuhum bi-imanin alhaqna bihim zurriyyatahum wa ma alatnahum min 'amalihim min shai'in kullumri'in bima kasaba raheen) (Surah At-Tur: 21), yani jo log iman layein aur un ke iman ki itteba' un ki aulad bhi kare hum un ki aulad ko bhi un se mila denge aur un ka koi 'amal kam na karenge. Darje mein sab ko barabari denge. Taake dono janib ki aankhein thandi rahein. Aur phir yeh na karenge ke darjon mein barhe huon ko neecha kardein nahin balkay neeche walon ko sirf apni rahmat-o-ehsan ke sath uncha kardein ge. Hazrat Sa'eed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain momin jannat mein jakar puche ga ke mera baap mere bhai meri aulad kahan hai? Jawab mile ga ke un ki nekiyan itni na thin ke woh is darje mein pahunchte, yeh kahe ga ke main ne toh apne liye aur un sab ke liye 'amal kiye the chunancha Allah Ta'ala unhein bhi un ke darje mein pahuncha de ga. Phir aap ne isi ayat (Rabbana wa adkhilhum jannati 'adninillati wa'attahum wa man salaha min aba'ihim wa azwajihim wa zurriyyatihim innaka antal-'azizul-hakim) (Surah Ghafir: 8) ki tilawat farmayi. Hazrat Mutarrif bin Abdullah R.A ka farman hai ke imandaron ki khair khwahi farishtay bhi karte hain phir aap ne yahi ayat parhi. Aur shayateen un ki badkhwahi karte hain. Tu aisa ghalib hai jis par koi ghalib nahin aur jise koi rok nahin sakta. Jo tu chahta hai hota hai aur jo nahin chahta nahin ho sakta.

Tu apne aqwal-o-af'al shariat-o-taqdeer mein hikmat wala hai, tu inhe buraiyon ke karne se duniya mein aur unke wabaal se dono jahan mein mehfooz rakh, Qayamat ke din rahmat wala wahi shumar ho sakta hai jise tu apni saza se aur apne azab se bacha le, haqeeqatan badi kamyabi, poori maqsad-dari aur zafryabi yahi hai.

Lekin un ki yeh aarzoo qabool na farmayi jayegi. Yeh hain hi jhoote.

Is ke baad jab unhein Jahannam mein daal diya jaye ga aur azaab shuru ho jayenge us waqt aur zyada zor-daar alfaaz mein yahi aarzoo karenge wahan cheekhte chillate hue kahenge (RABBANA AKHRIJNA NA'MAL SALIHAN GHAIRA-L-LAZI KUNNA NA'MAL) (35. Fatir: 37), Aye hamare Parwardigar hamein yahan se nikal de hum nek a'maal karte rahenge un ke khilaf jo ab tak karte rahe. Jawab mile ga ke kya hum ne unhein itni umr aur mohlat na di thi ke agar yeh nasihat hasil karne wale hote to yaqeenan kar sakte. Balkay tumhare paas hum ne aagah karne wale bhi bhej diye thay ab apne kartoot ka maza chakho zalimon ka koi madadgar nahin. Kahenge ke Allah hamein yahan se nikal de agar hum phir wahi karein to yaqeenan hum zalim thehrenge. Allah farmaye ga door ho jao isi mein pade raho aur mujh se kalam na karo. Is aayat mein un logon ne apne sawal se pehle ek muqaddama qaim kar ke sawal mein ek goona latafat kar di hai, Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat-e-kamilah ko bayan kiya ke Bari Ta'ala hum murda thay tu ne hamein zinda kar diya phir maar dala phir zinda kar diya. Phir tu har us cheez par jise tu chahe qadir hai. Hamein apne gunahon ka iqrar hai yaqeenan hum ne apni jaanon par zulm-o-ziyadati ki ab bachao ki koi surat bana de. Yani hamein duniya ki taraf phir lauta de jo yaqeenan tere bas mein hai hum wahan ja kar apne pehle a'maal ke khilaf a'maal karenge ab agar hum wahi kaam karein to beshak hum zalim hain. Unhein jawab diya jaye ga ke ab dobara duniya mein jaane ki koi raah nahin hai. Is liye ke agar dobara chale bhi jao ge to phir bhi wahi karoge jis se mana kiye gaye. Tum ne apne dil hi tedhay kar liye hain tum ab bhi haq ko qabool na karoge balkay us ke khilaf hi karoge. Tumhari to yeh halat thi ke jahan Allah Wahid ka zikr aaya wahin tumhare dil mein kufr samaya. Haan us ke sath kisi ko shareek kiya jaye to tumhein yaqeen-o-imaan aa jata tha. Yahi halat phir tumhari ho jaye gi. Duniya mein agar dobara gaye to phir bhi yahi karoge. Pas hakim-e-haqiqi jis ke hukm mein koi zulm na ho sara sar adl-o-insaf hi ho woh Allah Ta'ala hi hai jise chahe hidayat de jise chahe na de jis par chahe raham kare jise chahe azaab kare us ke hukm-o-adl mein koi us ka shareek nahin. Woh Allah apni qudratein logon par zahir karta hai. Zameen-o-aasman mein us ki tauheed ki beshumar nishaniyan majood hain. Jin se saaf zahir hai ke sab ka khaliq sab ka malik sab ka palanhar aur hifazat karne wala wahi hai. Woh aasman se rozi yani barish nazil farmata hai jis se har qisam ke anaaj ki khetiyan aur tarah tarah ke ajeeb ajeeb mazay ke mukhtalif rang roop aur shakal-o-waza ke meway aur phal phool paida hote hain halankay pani ek zameen ek. Lehaza is se bhi us ki shaan zahir hai. Sach to yeh hai ke ibrat-o-nasihat fikr-o-ghaur ki taufiq un hi ko hoti hai jo Allah ki taraf raghbat-o-rujoo karne wale hon, ab tum dua aur ibadat khuloos ke sath sirf Allah Wahid ki kiya karo.

Lekin un ki yeh aarzoo qabool na farmayi jayegi. Yeh hain hi jhoote.

Is ke baad jab unhein Jahannam mein daal diya jaye ga aur azaab shuru ho jayenge us waqt aur zyada zor-daar alfaaz mein yahi aarzoo karenge wahan cheekhte chillate hue kahenge (RABBANA AKHRIJNA NA'MAL SALIHAN GHAIRA-L-LAZI KUNNA NA'MAL) (35. Fatir: 37), Aye hamare Parwardigar hamein yahan se nikal de hum nek a'maal karte rahenge un ke khilaf jo ab tak karte rahe. Jawab mile ga ke kya hum ne unhein itni umr aur mohlat na di thi ke agar yeh nasihat hasil karne wale hote to yaqeenan kar sakte. Kahenge ke Allah hamein yahan se nikal de agar hum phir wahi karein to yaqeenan hum zalim thehrenge. Allah farmaye ga door ho jao isi mein pade raho aur mujh se kalam na karo. Yani hamein duniya ki taraf phir lauta de jo yaqeenan tere bas mein hai hum wahan ja kar apne pehle a'maal ke khilaf a'maal karenge ab agar hum wahi kaam karein to beshak hum zalim hain. Unhein jawab diya jaye ga ke ab dobara duniya mein jaane ki koi raah nahin hai. Is liye ke agar dobara chale bhi jao ge to phir bhi wahi karoge jis se mana kiye gaye. Tum ne apne dil hi tedhay kar liye hain tum ab bhi haq ko qabool na karoge balkay us ke khilaf hi karoge. Yahi halat phir tumhari ho jaye gi. Duniya mein agar dobara gaye to phir bhi yahi karoge. Pas hakim-e-haqiqi jis ke hukm mein koi zulm na ho sara sar adl-o-insaf hi ho woh Allah Ta'ala hi hai jise chahe hidayat de jise chahe na de jis par chahe raham kare jise chahe azaab kare us ke hukm-o-adl mein koi us ka shareek nahin. Woh Allah apni qudratein logon par zahir karta hai. Zameen-o-aasman mein us ki tauheed ki beshumar nishaniyan majood hain. Jin se saaf zahir hai ke sab ka khaliq sab ka malik sab ka palanhar aur hifazat karne wala wahi hai. Woh aasman se rozi yani barish nazil farmata hai jis se har qisam ke anaaj ki khetiyan aur tarah tarah ke ajeeb ajeeb mazay ke mukhtalif rang roop aur shakal-o-waza ke meway aur phal phool paida hote hain halankay pani ek zameen ek. Lehaza is se bhi us ki shaan zahir hai. Ke farishtay aur Rooh us ke paas charh kar jate hain. Aise din mein jis ki miqdar pachaas hazaar saal ki hai aur is baat ka bayan Insha'Allah aage aayega ke yeh doori saatween zameen se le kar Arsh tak ki hai, jaise salaf-o-khalaf ki ek jama'at ka qaul hai aur yahi raajih bhi hai Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Bahut se mufassireen se marwi hai ke Arsh surkh rang yaqoot ka hai jis ke do kinaron ki wus'at pachaas hazaar saal ki hai aur jis ki unchai saatween zameen se pachaas hazaar saal ki hai aur is se pehle is hadith mein jis mein farishton ka Arsh uthana bayan hua hai yeh bhi guzar chuka hai ke saaton aasmanon se bhi woh bahut buland aur bahut ooncha hai woh jis par chahe wahi bheje. Jaise (Yunazzilul-Mala'ikata bir-Roohi min amrihi 'ala man yashaa'u min 'ibadihi an anziroo annahu laa ilaaha illaa ana fattaqoon) (16. An-Nahl: 2), woh farishton ko wahi de kar apne hukm se jis ke paas chahta hai bhejta hai ke tum logon ko aagah kar do ke mere siwa koi ma'bood nahin mujh se darte raho aur jagah farman hai (Wa innahu latanzeelu Rabbil-'Aalameen) (26. Ash-Shu'ara: 192) yani yeh Quran tamam jahanon ke Rabb ka utara hua hai. Jise mo'tabar farishtay ne tere dil par utara hai. Taake tu darane wala ban jaye. Yahan bhi yahi farmaya ke woh mulaqat ke din se dara de. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh bhi Qayamat ka ek naam hai jis se Allah ne apne bandon ko daraya hai. Jis mein Hazrat Adam (A.S) khud aur un ki aulad mein se sab se aakhri bacha ek dusre se mil le ga. Ibn-e-Zaid farmate hain banday Allah se milenge. Qatadah farmate hain aasman wale aur zameen wale aapas mein mulaqat karenge. Khaliq-o-makhlooq, zalim-o-mazloom milenge. Maqsad yeh hai ke har ek dusre se mulaqat kare ga. Balkay aamil aur us ka amal bhi mile ga. Aaj sab Allah ke samne honge. Bilkul zahir-o-bahir honge, chupne ki to kahan saye ki jagah bhi koi na hogi. Sab us ke aamne samne majood honge. Is din khud Allah farmaye ga ke aaj badshahat kis ki hai? Kaun hoga jo jawab tak de? Phir khud hi jawab de ga ke Allah akele ki jo hamesha Wahid-o-Ahad hai aur sab par Ghalib-o-Hukmran hai. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke Allah Ta'ala aasman-o-zameen ko lapet kar apne haath mein le le ga aur farmaye ga. Main badshah hoon, main Jabbar hoon, Mutakabbir hoon. Zameen ke badshah aur Jabbar aur Mutakabbir log aaj kahan hain? Soor ki hadith mein hai ke Allah Azza-o-Jal jab tamam makhlooq ki rooh qabz kar le ga. Aur us Wahdahu La-Shareeka Lahu ke siwa aur koi baqi na rahe ga. Us waqt teen martaba farmaye ga aaj mulk kis ka hai? Phir khud hi jawab de ga Allah akele Ghalib ka.

Ya'ni us ka jo Wahid hai, us ka jo har cheez par Ghalib hai, jis ki malkiyat mein har cheez hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Qayamat ke qaim hone ke waqt ek munadi nida kare ga ke logo! Qayamat aa gayi, jise murde zinde sab sunenge. Allah Ta'ala aasman-e-dunya par nuzool-e-ijlal farmaye ga aur kahe ga aaj kis ke liye mulk hai? Sirf Allah akele Ghalba wale ke liye. Phir Allah Ta'ala ke adl-o-insaf ka bayan ho raha hai ke zara sa bhi zulm us din na hoga, balkay nekiyan das das guni kar ke milengi aur buraiyan utni hi rakhi jayengi. Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Allah Ta'ala ka farman naqal karte hain ke: "Ae mere bando! Main ne zulm karna apne upar bhi haram kar liya hai aur tum par bhi haram kar diya hai. Pas tum mein se koi kisi par zulm na kare." Aakhir mein hai: "Ae mere bando! Yeh to tumhare apne a'maal hain, jin par main nigah rakhta hoon aur jin ka poora badla doonga. Pas jo shakhs bhalai paye woh Allah ki hamd kare aur jo us ke siwa paye woh apne tayin hi malamat kare." Phir apne jald hisab lene ko bayan farmaya ke sari makhlooq se hisab lena us par aisa hai jaise ek shakhs ka hisab lena, jaise irshad-e-Bari hai: (Ma khalqukum wa la ba'thukum illa ka-nafsin wahidah, innallaha Sami'un Basir) (Surah Luqman: 28). Ya'ni tum sab ka paida karna aur tum sab ko marne ke baad zinda kar dena mere nazdeek ek shakhs ke paida karne aur zinda kar dene ki manind hai. Aur aayat mein hai, Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka farman hai: (Wa ma amruna illa wahidatun ka-lamhin bil-basar) (Surah Al-Qamar: 50). Bahut se mufassireen se marwi hai ke Arsh surkh rang yaqoot ka hai jis ke do kinaron ki wus'at pachaas hazaar saal ki hai aur jis ki unchai saatween zameen se pachaas hazaar saal ki hai aur is se pehle is hadith mein jis mein farishton ka Arsh uthana bayan hua hai yeh bhi guzar chuka hai ke saaton aasmanon se bhi woh bahut buland aur bahut ooncha hai woh jis par chahe wahi bheje. Jaise (Yunazzilul-Mala'ikata bir-Roohi min amrihi 'ala man yashaa'u min 'ibadihi an anziroo annahu laa ilaaha illaa ana fattaqoon) (16. An-Nahl: 2), woh farishton ko wahi de kar apne hukm se jis ke paas chahta hai bhejta hai ke tum logon ko aagah kar do ke mere siwa koi ma'bood nahin mujh se darte raho aur jagah farman hai (Wa innahu latanzeelu Rabbil-'Aalameen) (26. Ash-Shu'ara: 192) yani yeh Quran tamam jahanon ke Rabb ka utara hua hai. Jise mo'tabar farishtay ne tere dil par utara hai. Taake tu darane wala ban jaye. Yahan bhi yahi farmaya ke woh mulaqat ke din se dara de. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh bhi Qayamat ka ek naam hai jis se Allah ne apne bandon ko daraya hai. Jis mein Hazrat Adam (A.S) khud aur un ki aulad mein se sab se aakhri bacha ek dusre se mil le ga. Ibn-e-Zaid farmate hain banday Allah se milenge. Qatadah farmate hain aasman wale aur zameen wale aapas mein mulaqat karenge. Khaliq-o-makhlooq, zalim-o-mazloom milenge. Maqsad yeh hai ke har ek dusre se mulaqat kare ga. Balkay aamil aur us ka amal bhi mile ga. Aaj sab Allah ke samne honge. Bilkul zahir-o-bahir honge, chupne ki to kahan saye ki jagah bhi koi na hogi. Sab us ke aamne samne majood honge. Is din khud Allah farmaye ga ke aaj badshahat kis ki hai? Kaun hoga jo jawab tak de? Phir khud hi jawab de ga ke Allah akele ki jo hamesha Wahid-o-Ahad hai aur sab par Ghalib-o-Hukmran hai. Pehle hadith guzar chuki hai ke Allah Ta'ala aasman-o-zameen ko lapet kar apne haath mein le le ga aur farmaye ga. Main badshah hoon, main Jabbar hoon, Mutakabbir hoon. Zameen ke badshah aur Jabbar aur Mutakabbir log aaj kahan hain? Soor ki hadith mein hai ke Allah Azza-o-Jal jab tamam makhlooq ki rooh qabz kar le ga. Aur us Wahdahu La-Shareeka Lahu ke siwa aur koi baqi na rahe ga. Us waqt teen martaba farmaye ga aaj mulk kis ka hai? Phir khud hi jawab de ga Allah akele Ghalib ka.

Ya'ni us ka jo Wahid hai, us ka jo har cheez par Ghalib hai, jis ki malkiyat mein har cheez hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Qayamat ke qaim hone ke waqt ek munadi nida kare ga ke logo! Qayamat aa gayi, jise murde zinde sab sunenge. Allah Ta'ala aasman-e-dunya par nuzool-e-ijlal farmaye ga aur kahe ga aaj kis ke liye mulk hai? Sirf Allah akele Ghalba wale ke liye. Phir Allah Ta'ala ke adl-o-insaf ka bayan ho raha hai ke zara sa bhi zulm us din na hoga, balkay nekiyan das das guni kar ke milengi aur buraiyan utni hi rakhi jayengi. Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Allah Ta'ala ka farman naqal karte hain ke: "Ae mere bando! Main ne zulm karna apne upar bhi haram kar liya hai aur tum par bhi haram kar diya hai. Pas tum mein se koi kisi par zulm na kare." Aakhir mein hai: "Ae mere bando! Yeh to tumhare apne a'maal hain, jin par main nigah rakhta hoon aur jin ka poora badla doonga. Pas jo shakhs bhalai paye woh Allah ki hamd kare aur jo us ke siwa paye woh apne tayin hi malamat kare." Aur aayat mein hai, Allah Azza-wa-Jal ka farman hai: (Wa ma amruna illa wahidatun ka-lamhin bil-basar) (Surah Al-Qamar: 50). Ya'ni hamare hukm ke sath hi kaam ho jata hai, itni der mein jaise kisi ne aankh band kar ke khol li.

Al-gharaz isi nazdiki ki wajah se Qayamat ka naam Azfah hai. Us waqt kaleje munh ko aa jayenge. Woh khauf-o-haras hoga ke kisi ka dil thikane na rahega. Sab par ghazab ka sanata hoga. Kisi ke munh se koi baat na niklegi. Kya majal ke be-ijazat koi lab hila sake. Sab ro rahe honge aur hairan-o-pareshan honge. Jin logon ne Allah ke sath shirk kar ke apni janon par zulm kiya hai un ka aaj koi dost ghamgusar na hoga jo unhein kaam aaye. Na shafi aur sifarishi hoga jo un ki shafa'at ke liye zaban hilaye. Balkeh har bhalai ke asbab kat chuke honge, is Allah ka ilm muheet-e-kul hai. Tamam chhoti badi chhupi khuli bareek moti us par yaksan zahir-o-bahir hain, itne bade ilm wale se jis se koi cheez makhfi na ho har shakhs ko darna chahiye aur kisi waqt yeh khayal na karna chahiye ke is waqt woh mujh se posheeda hai aur mere haal ki use ittila nahin. Balkeh har waqt yeh yaqeen kar ke woh mujhe dekh raha hai us ka ilm mere sath hai us ka lihaz karta rahe aur us ke roke hue kamon se ruka rahe. Aankh jo khayanat ke liye uthti hai go bazahir woh amanat zahir kare. Lekin Rabb-e-Alim par woh makhfi nahin seene ke jis goshe mein jo khayal chhupa ho aur dil mein jo baat posheeda uthti ho us ka use ilm hai. Hazrat Zahhak farmate hain is se murad aankh marna ishare karna aur bin dekhi cheez ko dekhi hui ya dekhi hui cheez ko an-dekhi batana hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain. To na to koi use hata saka na kisi mein muqable ki taqat payi gayi na us se bachne ki koi surat nikli, Allah ka ghazab un par baras padne ki wajah yeh hui ke un ke paas bhi un ke rasool wazeh daleelein aur saaf roshan hujjatein le kar aaye bawajood is ke unhon ne kufr kiya jis par Allah ne unhein halak kar diya aur kuffar ke liye unhein ba'is-e-ibrat bana diya. Allah Ta'ala poori quwwat wala, sakht pakad wala, shadeed azab wala hai. Hamari dua hai ke woh hamein apne tamam azabon se nijat de.

Firaun ka badtareen hukum. Allah Ta'ala apne aakhri Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko tasalli dene ke liye sabqa rasoolon ke qisse bayan farmata hai ke jis tarah anjam-e-kaar fath-o-zafar un ke sath rahi isi tarah aap bhi in kuffar se koi andesha na kijiye. Meri madad aap ke sath hai. Anjam-e-kaar aap hi ki behtari aur bartari hogi jaise ke Hazrat Musa bin Imran (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ka waqia aap ke samne hai ke hum ne unhein dalail-o-barahin ke sath bheja, Qibtiyon ke badshah Firaun ki taraf jo Misr ka sultan tha aur Haman ki taraf jo us ka wazir-e-azam tha aur Qaroon ki taraf jo us ke zamane mein sab se zyada daulat-mand tha aur tajiron ka badshah samjha jata tha. In badnaseebon ne Allah ke is zabardast Rasool ko jhutlaya aur un ki tauheen ki aur saaf keh diya ke yeh to jadugar aur jhoota hai. Yehi jawab sabqa ummaton ke bhi Anbiya (A.S / Alaihimas Salam) ko dete hain. Jaise irshad hai (كَذٰلِكَ مَآ اَتَى الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا قَالُوْا سَاحِرٌ اَوْ مَجْنُوْنٌ 52؀ۚ) (Surah Az-Zariyat: 52), yani is tarah un se pehle bhi jitne rasool aaye sab se un ki qaum ne yehi kaha ke jadugar hai ya deewana hai. Kya unhon ne is par koi muttafiqa tajweez kar rakhi hai? Nahin balkay darasal yeh sab ke sab sarkash log hain, jab hamare Rasool Musa (A.S) un ke paas haq laye aur unhon ne Allah ke Rasool ko satana aur dukh dena shuru kiya aur Firaun ne hukum jari kar diya is Rasool par jo iman laye hain un ke han jo larke hain unhein qatl kar do aur jo larkiyan hon unhein zinda chhor do, is se pehle bhi woh yehi hukum jari kar chuka tha. Is liye ke use khauf tha ke kahin Musa paida na ho jayen ya is liye ke Bani Israel ki tadaad kam kar de aur unhein kamzor aur be-taqat bana de aur mumkin hai dono maslahatein samne hon aur un ki ginti na barhe aur yeh past-o-zaleel rahen balkay unhein khayal ho ke hamari is museebat ka ba'is Hazrat Musa hain. Chunancha Bani Israel ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) se kaha ke aap ke aane se pehle bhi hamein eeza di gayi aur aap ke tashreef lane ke baad bhi hum sataye gaye. Aap ne jawab diya tum jaldi na karo bahut mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala tumhare dushman ko barbad kar de aur tumhein zameen ka khalifa banaye phir dekhe ke tum kaise amal karte ho? Hazrat Qatada (R.H / Rahimahullah) ka qaul hai ke Firaun ka yeh hukum dobara tha. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke kuffar ka fareb aur un ki yeh policy ke Bani Israel fana ho jayen be-faida aur fazool thi. Firaun ka ek badtareen qasd bayan ho raha hai ke us ne Hazrat Musa ke qatl ka irada kiya aur apni qaum se kaha mujhe chhoro main Musa ko qatl kar daloon ga woh agarche apne Allah ko bhi apni madad ke liye pukare mujhe koi parwah nahin. Mujhe dar hai ke agar use zinda chhora gaya to woh tumhare deen ko badal de ga tumhari aadat-o-rusumaat ko tum se chura de ga aur zameen mein ek fasad phaila de ga. Isi liye Arab mein yeh misl mashhoor ho gayi "Sara Firaunu mudakkiran" yani Firaun bhi wa'iz ban gaya.

Baaz qira'aton mein bajaye 'an yattahira' ke 'yattahura' hai, Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko jab Firaun ka yeh bad irada maloom hua toh aap ne farmaya main is ki aur is jaise logon ki burai se Allah ki panah mein aata hoon. Ae mere mukhatib logo! Main har us shakhs ki eza-rasani se jo haq se takabbur karne wala aur Qayamat ke din par iman na rakhne wala ho, apne aur tumhare Rab ki panah mein aata hoon. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke jab Janab-e-Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko kisi qoum se khauf hota toh aap yeh dua parhte yani Ae Allah! In ki burai se hum Teri panah mein aate hain aur hum Tujh par in ke muqable mein bharosa karte hain.

Isi liye Arab mein yeh misl mashhoor ho gayi "Sara Firaunu mudakkiran" yani Firaun bhi wa'iz ban gaya.

Baaz qira'aton mein bajaye 'an yattahira' ke 'yattahura' hai, Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko jab Firaun ka yeh bad irada maloom hua toh aap ne farmaya main is ki aur is jaise logon ki burai se Allah ki panah mein aata hoon. Ae mere mukhatib logo! Main har us shakhs ki eza-rasani se jo haq se takabbur karne wala aur Qayamat ke din par iman na rakhne wala ho, apne aur tumhare Rab ki panah mein aata hoon. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke jab Janab-e-Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko kisi qoum se khauf hota toh aap yeh dua parhte yani Ae Allah! In ki burai se hum Teri panah mein aate hain aur hum Tujh par in ke muqable mein bharosa karte hain.

Ek mard-e-momin ki Firaun ko nasihat. Mashhoor toh yahi hai ke yeh momin Qibti thay (Rahimahullah) aur Firaun ke khandan ke thay. Balkay Suddi farmatay hain Firaun ke yeh chacha zaad bhai thay aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke unhon ne bhi Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke sath nijat payi thi. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir bhi isi qaul ko pasand farmatay hain. Balkay jin logon ka qaul hai ke yeh momin bhi Israeli thay, aap ne un ki tardeed ki hai aur kaha hai ke agar yeh Israeli hotay toh na Firaun is tarah sabr se un ki nasihat sunta na Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke qatl ke iraday se baaz aata. Balkay unhein eeza pahunchata. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marvi hai Aal-e-Firaun mein se ek toh yeh mard-e-imandar tha aur dusray Firaun ki biwi iman layi thin. Teesra woh shakhs jis ne Hazrat Musa (A.S) ko khabar di thi ke sardaron ka mashwara tumhein qatl karne ka ho raha hai. Yeh apne iman ko chupatay rehtay thay lekin qatl-e-Musa (A.S) ki sun kar zabt na ho saki aur yahi darhaqiqat sab se behtar aur afzal jihad hai ke zalim badshah ke samnay insan kalma-e-haq keh de. Jaise ke hadith mein hai, aur Firaun ke samnay is se zyada bada kalma koi na tha. Pas yeh shakhs bohat buland martabay ke mujahid thay. Jin ke muqablay ka koi nazar nahin aata. Albatta Sahih Bukhari Sharif waghera mein ek waqia kayi riwayaton se marvi hai jis ka mahasil yeh hai ke Hazrat Urwah bin Zubair ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin Aas (R.A) se ek martaba poocha ke sab se badi eeza mushrikon ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko kya pahunchayi hai? Aap ne farmaya suno ek roz Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Kaaba Sharif mein namaz padh rahay thay ke Uqba bin Abi Mu'ait aaya aur aap ko pakad liya aur apni chadar mein bal de kar aap ki gardan mein daal kar ghaseetnay laga jis se aap ka gala ghutnay laga. Isi waqt Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) dauday dauday aaye aur usay dhakka de kar paray phenka aur farmanay lagay kya tum is shakhs ko qatl karna chahtay ho jo kehta hai ke mera Rab Allah hai aur woh tumharay paas daleelein le kar aaya hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Quraishiyon ka majma jama tha jab aap wahan se guzray toh unhon ne kaha kya tu hi hai? Jo hamein hamaray baap dadon ke maboodon ki ibadat se mana karta hai? Aap ne farmaya haan haan main hi hoon. Is par woh sab aap ko chimat gaye aur kapray ghaseetnay lagay. Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ne aa kar aap ko chudaya aur poori aayat "Ataqtuluna" ki tilawat ki. Pas is momin ne bhi yahi kaha ke is ka qasoor toh sirf itna hi hai ke yeh apna Rab Allah ko batata hai aur jo kehta hai us par sanad aur daleel pesh karta hai. Acha maan lo bilfarz yeh jhoota hai toh is ke jhoot ka wabaal isi par paday ga Allah Subhan-o-Ta'ala usay duniya aur aakhirat mein saza de ga aur agar woh sacha hai aur tum ne usay sataya dukh diya toh yaqeenan tum par azab-e-Allah baras paday ga jaise ke woh keh raha hai. Pas aqlan lazim hai ke tum usay chhod do jo is ki maan rahay hain manein. Tum kyun is ke darpay-e-aazar ho rahay hain? Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne bhi Firaun aur qaum-e-Firaun se yahi chaha tha.

Jaise ke aayat (Walaqad fatanna qablahum qawma Fir'auna waja'ahum rasulun karim) (Surah Ad-Dukhan: 17) tak hai yani hum ne un se pehle qawm-e-Fir'aun ko aazmaya un ke paas Rasul-e-Karim ko bheja. Us ne kaha ke Allah ke bandon ko mujhe sonp do. Main tumhari taraf Rabb ka rasul-e-amin hoon. Tum Allah se baghawat na karo. Dekho main tumhare paas khuli daleelein aur zabardast mojize laya hoon. Tum mujhe sangsar kar doge is se main Allah ki panah leta hoon, agar tum mujh par iman nahin late to mujhe chhod do, yehi Janab-e-Rasul-e-Aakhir-uz-Zaman (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apni qawm se farmaya tha ke Allah ke bandon ko Allah ki taraf mujhe pukarne do tum meri eeza-rasani se baaz raho. Aur meri qarabat-dari ko khayal karte hue mujhe dukh na do. Sulh-e-Hudaibiya bhi darasal yehi cheez thi jo khuli fatah kehlayi. Woh momin kehta hai ke suno musrif aur jhoote aadmi rah-yafta nahin hote. Un ke saath Allah ki nusrat nahin hoti. Un ke aqwal-o-af'aal bahut jald un ki khabasat ko zahir kar dete hain. Barkhilaf is ke ye Nabi Allah ikhtilaf-o-iztirab se paak hain. Sahi sacchi aur achi rah par hain. Zaban ke sacche amal ke pakke hain. Agar ye had se guzar jane wale aur jhoote hote to ye rasti aur umdagi in mein hargiz na hoti, phir qawm ko nasihat karte hain aur unhein Allah ke azab se darate hain bhaiyo! Tumhein Allah ne is mulk ki saltanat ata farmayi hai. Badi izzat di hai. Tumhara hukm jaari kar rakha hai. Allah ki is ne'mat par tumhein is ka shukr karna chahiye aur is ke rasulon ko saccha manna chahiye. Yaad rakho agar tum ne nashukri ki aur rasul ki taraf buri nazrein dalein. To yaqeenan azab-e-Allah tum par aa jayega. Batao us waqt kise laoge? Jo tumhari madad par khada ho aur Allah ke azab ko roke ya tale? Ye lao lashkar ye jaan-o-maal kuch kaam na aayenge. Fir'aun se aur to koi maqool jawab ban na pada khisiyana ban kar qawm mein apni khair-khwahi jatane laga ke main dhoka nahin de raha jo mera khayal hai aur mere zehen mein hai wohi tum par zahir kar raha hoon. Halan-ke darasal ye bhi us ki khayanat thi. Woh bhi janta tha ke Hazrat Musa (A.S) Allah ke sacche rasul hain. Jaise farman-e-Bari hai (Laqad 'alimta ma anzala ha'ula'i illa Rabbus-samawati wal-ardi basa'ira wa inni la-azunnuka ya Fir'aunu mathbura) (Surah Al-Isra: 102) yani Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne farmaya ae Fir'aun tu khoob janta hai ke ye aja'ibaat khaas aasman-o-zameen ke Parwardigar ne bheje hain. Jo ke baseerat ke zaraye hain aur aayat mein hai (Wajahadu biha wastaiqanat-ha anfusuhum zulman wa 'uluwwan fanzur kaifa kana 'aqibatul-mufsideen) (Surah An-Naml: 14), yani unhon ne bawajood dili yaqeen ke az rah-e-zulm-o-ziyadati inkar kar diya. Isi tarah us ka ye kehna bhi sarasar ghalat tha ke main tumhein haq ki sacchai ki aur bhalai ki rah dikhata hoon. Is mein woh logon ko dhoka de raha tha aur ra'iyat ki khayanat kar raha tha.

Lekin us ki qoum us ke dhoke mein aa gayi aur Firaun ki baat maan li. Firaun ne unhein kisi bhalai ki raah na dala. Us ka amal hi theek nahin tha aur jagah Allah Azzawajal farmata hai Firaun ne apni qoum ko baha diya aur unhein sahih raah tak na pahunchne diya na pahunchaya. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo imam apni ri'aya se khayanat kar raha ho woh mar kar jannat ki khushbu bhi nahin pata. Halankeh woh khushbu paanch sau saal ki raah par aati hai. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala Al-Muwaffiq lis-Sawab.

Mard-e-Momin ki apni qoum ko nasihat. Is Momin ki nasihat ka aakhri hissa bayan ho raha hai ke usne farmaya dekho agar tumne Allah ke Rasool ki na maani aur apni sarkashi par ade rahe toh mujhe dar yeh hai ke kahin sabqa qoumon ki tarah tum par bhi azab-e-Allah ka baras na pade. Qoum-e-Nuh aur Qoum-e-Ad-o-Samood ko dekh lo ke paighambaron ki na maanne ke wabaal mein un par kaise azab aaye? Aur koi na tha jo unhein taalta ya rokta. Is mein Allah ka kuch zulm na tha uski zaat bandon par zulm karne se paak hai unke apne kartoot thay jo unke liye wabaal-e-jaan ban gaye, mujhe tum par Qayamat ke din ke azab ka bhi dar hai. Jo haank pukaar ka din hai. Soor ki hadith mein hai ke jab zameen mein zalzala aayega aur phat jayegi toh log maare ghabrahat ke idhar udhar pareshan-e-hawas bhaagne lagenge. Aur ek dusre ko aawaz denge. Hazrat Zahhak waghera ka qaul hai ke yeh us waqt ka zikr hai jab Jahannam layi jayegi aur log use dekh kar dar kar bhaagenge aur farishtay unhein maidan-e-mahshar ki taraf wapas layenge. Jaise farman-e-Allah hai (Wal-malaku 'ala arja'iha, wa yahmilu 'arsha rabbika fawqahum yawma'izin thamaniyah) (69. Al-Haqqah: 17) yani farishtay uske kinaron par honge. Aur farman hai (Ya ma'sharal-jinni wal-insi inistata'tum an tanfuzu min aqtaris-samawati wal-ardi fanfuzu, la tanfuzuna illa bisultan) (55. Ar-Rahman: 33), yani ae insano! Aur jino! Agar tum zameen-o-aasman ke kinaron se bhaag nikalne ki taqat rakhte ho toh nikal bhaago lekin yeh tumhare bas ki baat nahin. Hasan aur Zahhak ki qira'at mein Yawmut-Tanad daal ki tashdeed ke saath hai. Aur yeh makhooz hai nidal-ba'eer se, jab oont chala jaye aur sarkashi karne lage toh yeh lafz kaha jata hai, kaha gaya hai ke jis tarazu mein amal tole jayenge wahan ek farishta hoga jis ki nekiyan badh jayengi woh ba-aawaz-e-buland pukaar kar kahega logo falan ka ladka falan sa'adat wala ho gaya aur aaj ke baad se us par shaqawat kabhi nahin aayegi aur uski nekiyan ghat gayin toh woh farishta aawaz lagayega ke falan bin falan badnaseeb ho gaya aur tabah-o-barbad ho gaya. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain Qayamat ko Yawmut-Tanad is liye kaha gaya hai ke Jannati Jannatiyon ko aur Jahannami Jahannamiyon ko pukaarenge aur a'maal ke saath pukaarenge aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke wajah yeh hai ke Jannati dozakhiyon ko pukaarenge aur kahenge ke hamare Rab ne hum se jo waada kiya tha woh hum ne sach paya. Tum batao ke kya tumne bhi apne Rab ka waada sacha paya? Woh jawab denge haan. Isi tarah Jahannami Jannatiyon ko pukaar kar kahenge ke hamein thoda sa paani hi chhua do ya woh kuch de do jo Allah ne tumhein de rakha hai. Jannati jawab denge ke yahan ke khane peene ko Allah ne kafiron par haram kar diya hai isi tarah Surah A'raf mein yeh bhi bayan hai ke A'raf wale dozakhiyon aur Jannatiyon ko pukaarenge.

Baghwi waghera farmate hain ke yeh tamam baatein hain aur in sab wajooh ki bina par Qayamat ke din ka naam Yaum-ut-Tanad hai. Yehi qaul bahut umdah hai wallahu a'lam, is din log peeth pher kar bhaag kharay honge. Lekin bhaagne ki koi jagah na payenge aur keh diya jayega ke aaj theherne ki jagah yehi hai is din koi na hoga jo bacha sake aur Allah ke azab se chura sake baat yeh hai ke Allah ke siwa koi Qadir-e-Mutlaq nahin woh jise gumrah kar de use koi hidayat nahin de sakta, phir farmata hai ke is se pehle Ahl-e-Misr ke paas Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) Allah ke paighambar ban kar aaye thay. Aap ki ba'sat Hazrat Musa (A.S) se pehle hui thi. Aziz-e-Misr bhi aap hi thay aur apni ummat ko Allah ki taraf bulate thay. Lekin qaum ne un ki ita'at na ki, haan ba-wajah dunyawi jaah ke aur wazarat ke to unhein matah'ti karni padti thi. Pas farmata hai ke tum un ki nabuwwat ki taraf se bhi shak mein hi rahe. Aakhir jab un ka inteqal ho gaya to tum bilkul mayoos ho gaye aur umeed karte hue kehne lage ke ab to Allah Ta'ala kisi ko nabi bana kar bheje ga hi nahin. Yeh tha un ka kufr aur un ki takzeeb isi tarah Allah Ta'ala use gumrah kar deta hai jo be-ja kaam karne wala had se guzar jane wala aur shak shuba mein mubtala rehne wala ho. Ya'ni jo tumhara haal hai yehi haal un sab ka hota hai jin ke kaam israf wale hon aur jin ka dil shak shuba wala ho, jo log haq ko batil se hatate hain aur baghair daleel ke daleelon ko taalte hain is par Allah un se na-khush hai aur sakht tar naraz hai. Un ke yeh af'aal jahan Allah ki narazgi ka ba'is hain wahan imandaron ki bhi na-khushi ka zariya hain. Jin logon mein aisi behooda sifatein hoti hain un ke dil par Allah Ta'ala mohar kar deta hai jis ke baad unhein na achhai achhi maloom hoti hai na burai buri lagti hai. Har woh shakhs jo haq se sarkashi karne wala ho aur takabbur-o-ghuroor wala ho. Hazrat Sha'bi farmate hain jabbar woh shakhs hai jo do insanon ko qatl kar dale. Abu Imran Joni aur Qatada ka farman hai ke jo baghair haq ke kisi ko qatl kare woh jabbar hai. Wallahu Ta'ala A'lam.

Aur farman hai (Ya ma'sharal-jinni wal-insi inistata'tum an tanfuzu min aqtaris-samawati wal-ardi fanfuzu, la tanfuzuna illa bisultan) (55. Ar-Rahman: 33), yani ae insano! Aur jino! Agar tum zameen-o-aasman ke kinaron se bhaag nikalne ki taqat rakhte ho toh nikal bhaago lekin yeh tumhare bas ki baat nahin. Hasan aur Zahhak ki qira'at mein Yawmut-Tanad daal ki tashdeed ke saath hai. Aur yeh makhooz hai nidal-ba'eer se, jab oont chala jaye aur sarkashi karne lage toh yeh lafz kaha jata hai, kaha gaya hai ke jis tarazu mein amal tole jayenge wahan ek farishta hoga jis ki nekiyan badh jayengi woh ba-aawaz-e-buland pukaar kar kahega logo falan ka ladka falan sa'adat wala ho gaya aur aaj ke baad se us par shaqawat kabhi nahin aayegi aur uski nekiyan ghat gayin toh woh farishta aawaz lagayega ke falan bin falan badnaseeb ho gaya aur tabah-o-barbad ho gaya. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain Qayamat ko Yawmut-Tanad is liye kaha gaya hai ke Jannati Jannatiyon ko aur Jahannami Jahannamiyon ko pukaarenge aur a'maal ke saath pukaarenge aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke wajah yeh hai ke Jannati dozakhiyon ko pukaarenge aur kahenge ke hamare Rab ne hum se jo waada kiya tha woh hum ne sach paya. Tum batao ke kya tumne bhi apne Rab ka waada sacha paya? Woh jawab denge haan. Isi tarah Jahannami Jannatiyon ko pukaar kar kahenge ke hamein thoda sa paani hi chhua do ya woh kuch de do jo Allah ne tumhein de rakha hai. Jannati jawab denge ke yahan ke khane peene ko Allah ne kafiron par haram kar diya hai isi tarah Surah A'raf mein yeh bhi bayan hai ke A'raf wale dozakhiyon aur Jannatiyon ko pukaarenge.

Baghwi waghera farmate hain ke yeh tamam baatein hain aur in sab wajooh ki bina par Qayamat ke din ka naam Yaum-ut-Tanad hai. Yehi qaul bahut umdah hai wallahu a'lam, is din log peeth pher kar bhaag kharay honge. Lekin bhaagne ki koi jagah na payenge aur keh diya jayega ke aaj theherne ki jagah yehi hai is din koi na hoga jo bacha sake aur Allah ke azab se chura sake baat yeh hai ke Allah ke siwa koi Qadir-e-Mutlaq nahin woh jise gumrah kar de use koi hidayat nahin de sakta, phir farmata hai ke is se pehle Ahl-e-Misr ke paas Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) Allah ke paighambar ban kar aaye thay. Aap ki ba'sat Hazrat Musa (A.S) se pehle hui thi. Aziz-e-Misr bhi aap hi thay aur apni ummat ko Allah ki taraf bulate thay. Lekin qaum ne un ki ita'at na ki, haan ba-wajah dunyawi jaah ke aur wazarat ke to unhein matah'ti karni padti thi. Pas farmata hai ke tum un ki nabuwwat ki taraf se bhi shak mein hi rahe. Aakhir jab un ka inteqal ho gaya to tum bilkul mayoos ho gaye aur umeed karte hue kehne lage ke ab to Allah Ta'ala kisi ko nabi bana kar bheje ga hi nahin. Yeh tha un ka kufr aur un ki takzeeb isi tarah Allah Ta'ala use gumrah kar deta hai jo be-ja kaam karne wala had se guzar jane wala aur shak shuba mein mubtala rehne wala ho. Ya'ni jo tumhara haal hai yehi haal un sab ka hota hai jin ke kaam israf wale hon aur jin ka dil shak shuba wala ho, jo log haq ko batil se hatate hain aur baghair daleel ke daleelon ko taalte hain is par Allah un se na-khush hai aur sakht tar naraz hai. Un ke yeh af'aal jahan Allah ki narazgi ka ba'is hain wahan imandaron ki bhi na-khushi ka zariya hain. Jin logon mein aisi behooda sifatein hoti hain un ke dil par Allah Ta'ala mohar kar deta hai jis ke baad unhein na achhai achhi maloom hoti hai na burai buri lagti hai. Har woh shakhs jo haq se sarkashi karne wala ho aur takabbur-o-ghuroor wala ho. Hazrat Sha'bi farmate hain jabbar woh shakhs hai jo do insanon ko qatl kar dale. Abu Imran Joni aur Qatada ka farman hai ke jo baghair haq ke kisi ko qatl kare woh jabbar hai. Wallahu Ta'ala A'lam.

Firaun ki sarkashi aur takabbur. Firaun ki sarkashi aur takabbur bayan ho raha hai ke usne apne wazir Haman se kaha ke mere liye ek buland-o-bala mahal tameer kara. Eenton aur choone ki pukhta aur bahut oonchi imarat bana. Jaise aur jagah hai ke usne kaha ae Haman eentein paka kar mere liye ek oonchi imarat bana. Hazrat (R.H) ka qaul hai ke qabr ko pukhta banana aur use choone gaj karna salaf-e-saliheen makrooh jaante thay. (Ibn Abi Hatim) Firaun kehta hai ke yeh mahal main is liye banwa raha hoon ke aasman ke darwazon aur aasman ke raston tak main pahunch jaoon aur Musa (A.S) ke Allah ko dekh loon go main jaanta hoon ke Musa (A.S) hai jhoota. Woh jo keh raha hai ke Allah ne use bheja hai yeh bilkul ghalat hai, darasal Firaun ka yeh ek makr tha aur woh apni ra'iyat par yeh zahir karna chahta tha ke dekho main aisa kaam karta hoon jis se Musa (A.S) ka jhoot bilkul khul jaye aur meri tarah tumhein bhi yaqeen aa jaye ke Musa (A.S) ghalat-go, muftari aur kazzab hai. Firaun rah-e-Allah se rok diya gaya. Isi ki har tadbeer ulti hi rahi aur jo kaam woh karta hai woh us ke liye nuqsan-deh hota hai aur woh khasare mein barhta hi ja raha hai.

Qaum-e-Firaun ke mard-e-momin ki seh-barah nasihat. Firaun ki qaum ka momin mard jis ka zikr pehle guzar chuka hai apni qaum ke sarkashon, khud-pasandon aur mutakabbiron ko nasihat karte hue kehta hai ke tum meri mano, meri rah chalo, main tumhein rah-e-rast par daal doonga. Yeh apne is qaul mein Firaun ki tarah kazib na tha. Yeh to apni qaum ko dhoka de raha tha aur yeh un ki haqeeqi khair-khwahi kar raha tha, phir unhein duniya se be-raghbat karne aur aakhirat ki taraf mutawajja karne ke liye kehta hai ke duniya ek dhal jaane wala saya aur fana ho jaane wala faida hai. Lazawal aur qarar-o-hamishgi wali jagah to is ke baad aane wali aakhirat hai. Jahan ki rahmat-o-zahmat labadi aur ghair-fani hai, jahan burai ka badla to is ke barabar hi diya jata hai, haan neki ka badla be-hisab diya jata hai. Neki karne wala chahe mard ho, chahe aurat ho. Haan yeh shart hai ke ho ba-iman. Use is neki ka sawab is qadar diya jaye ga jo be-had-o-be-hisab hoga.

Aalam-e-Barzakh mein azaab par daleel. Qaum-e-Firaun ka momin mard apna wa'az jaari rakhte hue kehta hai ke yeh kya baat hai ke main tumhein tauheed ki taraf yani Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki ibadat ki taraf bula raha hoon. Main tumhein Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq karne ki dawat de raha hoon. Aur tum mujhe kufr-o-shirk ki taraf bula rahe ho? Tum chahte ho ke main jahil ban jaaun aur be-daleel Allah aur uske Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khilaf karoon? Ghaur karo ke tumhari aur meri dawat mein kis qadar farq hai? Main tumhein us Allah ki taraf le jana chahta hoon jo badi izzat aur kibriyai wala hai. Bawajood iske woh har us shakhs ki tauba qabool karta hai jo uski taraf jhuke aur istighfar kare, lajaram ke ma'ani haq-o-sadaqat ke hain, yani yeh yaqeeni sach aur haq hai ke jis ki taraf tum mujhe bula rahe ho yani buton aur siwaye Allah ke dusron ki ibadat ki taraf yeh toh woh hain jinhein deen-o-duniya ka koi ikhtiyar nahin. Jinhein nafa nuqsan par koi qabu nahin jo apne pukarne wale ki pukaar ko sun sakein toh qabool kar sakein na yahan na wahan. Jaise farman-e-Allah hai (Wa man adallu mimman yad'u min dunillahi mal la yastajibu lahu ila yaumil qiyamati wa hum an du'aihim ghafilun) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 5), yani is se badh kar koi gumrah nahin jo Allah ke siwa auron ko pukarta hai. Jo uski pukaar ko qayamat tak sun nahin sakte. Jinhein mutlaq khabar nahin ke kaun hamein pukaar raha hai? Jo qayamat ke din apne pukarne walon ke dushman ho jayenge aur unki ibadat se bilkul inkar kar jayenge. Go tum unhein pukara karo lekin woh nahin sunte. Aur bilfarz agar sun bhi lein toh qabool nahin kar sakte. Momin-e-Aal-e-Firaun kehta hai, ke hum sab ko laut kar Allah hi ke paas jana hai. Wahan har ek ko apne a'maal ka badla bhugatna hai. Wahan had se guzar jane wale Allah ke sath dusron ko shareek karne wale hamesha ke liye jahannam wasil kar diye jayenge, go tum is waqt meri baton ki qadr na karo. Lekin abhi abhi tumhein maloom ho jayega meri baton ki sadaqat-o-haqqaniyat tum par wazeh ho jayegi. Us waqt nidamat, hasrat aur afsos karoge lekin woh mehez be-sud hoga. Main toh apna kaam Allah ke supurd karta hoon. Mera tawakkul usi ki zaat par hai. Main toh apne har kaam mein usi se madad talab karta hoon. Mujhe tum se koi wasta nahin main tum se alag hoon aur tumhare kamon se nafrat karta hoon. Mera tumhara koi ta'alluq nahin. Allah apne bandon ke tamam halaat se dana-o-beena hai. Mustahiq-e-hidayat jo hain unki woh rehnumai karega aur mustahiqeen-e-zalalat is rehnumai se mehroom rahenge, uska har kaam hikmat wala aur uski har tadbeer achhai wali hai. Is momin ko Allah Ta'ala ne Firauniyon ke makr se bacha liya. Duniya mein bhi woh mehfooz raha yani Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke sath usne nijat payi aur aakhirat ke azaab se bhi mehfooz raha. Baqi tamam Firauni badtareen azaab ka shikar hue. Sab darya mein dubo diye gaye, phir wahan se jahannam wasil kar diye gaye.

Har subh-o-sham un ki roohein jahannam ke samne layi jati hain, Qayamat tak yeh azab unhein hota rahega. Aur Qayamat ke din un ki roohein jism samet jahannam mein daal di jayengi. Aur us din un se kaha jayega ke ae Aal-e-Firaun sakht dard-naak aur bahut zyada takleef-deh azab mein chale jao. Yeh aayat Ahl-e-Sunnat ke us mazhab ki ke Aalam-e-Barzakh mein yani qabron mein azab hota hai bahut badi daleel hai, han yahan yeh baat yaad rakhni chahiye ke baaz ahadees mein kuch aise mazameen warid hue hain jin se maloom hota hai ke azab-e-barzakh ka ilm Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Madine Sharif ki hijrat ke baad hua aur yeh aayat Makka Sharif mein nazil hui hai. Toh jawab is ka yeh hai ke aayat se sirf itna maloom hota hai ke mushrikon ki roohein subh-o-sham jahannam ke samne pesh ki jati hain. Baqi rahi baat ke yeh azab har waqt jaari aur baqi rehta hai ya nahin? Aur yeh bhi ke aaya yeh azab sirf rooh ko hi hota hai ya jism ko bhi, is ka ilm Allah ki taraf se Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Madine Sharif mein karaya gaya. Aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ise bayan farma diya. Pas hadees-o-Quran mila kar masla yeh hua ke azab-o-sawab-e-qabr, rooh aur jism dono ko hota hai aur yahi haq hai. Ab in ahadees ko mulahiza farmaiye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek Yahudiya aurat Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ki khidmat-guzar thi. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) jab kabhi us ke sath kuch sulook karti toh woh dua deti aur kehti Allah tujhe jahannam ke azab se bachaye. Ek roz Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya Qayamat se pehle qabr mein bhi azab hota hai? Aur woh toh us se zyada jhoot Allah par bandha karte hain. Qayamat se pehle koi azab nahin. Kuch hi din guzre the ke ek martaba Zohar ke waqt kapda lapete hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye aankhein surkh ho rahi thin aur ba-awaz-e-buland farma rahe the qabr manind siyah raat ki andheriyon ke tukdon ke hai. Logo agar tum woh jante jo main janta hoon toh bahut zyada rote aur bahut kam hanste, logo! Qabr ke azab se Allah ki panah talab karo, yaqeen mano ke azab-e-qabr haq hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek Yahudiya aurat ne Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se kuch manga jo Aap (R.A) ne diya aur us ne woh dua di us ke aakhir mein hai ke kuch dinon baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe wahi ki gayi hai ke tumhari aazmaish qabron mein ki jati hai. Pas in ahadees aur aayat mein ek tatbeeq toh woh hai jo oopar bayan hui. Dusri tatbeeq yeh bhi ho sakti hai ke aayat 'yu'razuna' se sirf is qadar sabit hota hai ke kuffar ko Aalam-e-Barzakh mein azab hota hai. Lekin is se yeh lazim nahin aata ke momin ko yahan ke baaz gunahon ki wajah se us ki qabr mein azab hota hai. Yeh sirf hadees-e-sharif se sabit hua. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas ek din Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye us waqt ek Yahudiya aurat mai-sahiba ke paas baithi thi aur keh rahi thi ke kya aap ko maloom hai ke tum log apni qabron mein aazmaye jaoge? Ise sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kanp gaye aur farmaya Yahood hi aazmaye jate hain.

Phir chand dinon baad Aap ne farmaya logo tum sab qabron ke fitna mein daale jaoge. Is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) fitna-e-qabr se panah manga karte the. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke aayat se sirf rooh ke azaab ka suboot milta tha. Is se jism tak is azaab ke pahunchne ka suboot nahin tha. Baad mein bazariya-e-wahi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh maloom karaya gaya ke azaab-e-qabr jism-o-rooh ko hota hai. Chunancha Aap ne phir is se bachao ki dua shuru ki, Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas ek Yahudiya aurat aayi aur us ne kaha azaab-e-qabr se hum Allah ki panah chahte hain is par Siddiqa (R.A) ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke kya qabr mein azaab hota hai? Aap ne farmaya haan azaab-e-qabr bar-haq hai farmati hain is ke baad main ne dekha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) har namaz ke baad azaab-e-qabr se panah manga karte the. Is hadith se toh sabit hota hai ke Aap ne ise sunte hi Yahudiya aurat ki tasdeeq ki. Aur oopar wali ahadees se maloom hota hai ke Aap ne takzeeb ki thi. Donon mein tatbeeq yeh hai ke yeh do waqiye hain pehle waqiye ke waqt chunke wahi se Aap ko maloom nahin hua tha Aap ne inkaar farma diya. Phir maloom ho gaya toh Aap ne iqrar kiya, Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Qabr ke azaab ka zikr bahut si sahih ahadees mein aa chuka hai. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain rehti duniya tak har subh-o-sham Aal-e-Firaun ki roohein jahannam ke samne layi jaati hain aur un se kaha jaata hai ke badkaro tumhari asli jagah yahi hai taake un ke ranj-o-gham barhein un ki zillat-o-tauheen ho. Pas aaj bhi woh azaab mein hi hain. Aur hamesha isi mein rahenge. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ka qaul hai ke shaheedon ki roohein sabz rang ke parindon ke qalib mein hain woh jannat mein jahan kahin chahein chalti phirti hain. Aur mominon ke bachon ki roohein chiriyon ke qalib mein hain aur jahan woh chahein jannat mein chalti rehti hain. Aur arsh tale ki qandeelon mein aaram hasil karti hain. Aur Aal-e-Firaun ki roohein siyah rang parindon ke qalib mein hain. Subh bhi jahannam ke paas jaati hain. Aur sham ko bhi yahi un ka pesh hona hai. Meraj wali lambi riwayat mein hai ke phir mujhe ek bahut bari makhlooq ki taraf le chale jin mein se har ek ka pait misl bahut bare ghar ke tha. Jo Aal-e-Firaun ke paas qaid the. Aur Aal-e-Firaun subh sham aag par laye jaate hain. Aur jis din Qayamat qaim hogi Allah Ta'ala farmayega. In Firauniyon ko sakht tar azaabon mein le jao aur yeh Firauni log nakeel wale oonton ki tarah munh neeche kiye patthar aur darakht par charh rahe hain aur bilkul be-aql-o-shaoor hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jo ehsan kare khwah muslim ho khwah kafir Allah Ta'ala use zaroor badla deta hai hum ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kafir ko kya badla milta hai? Farmaya agar us ne sila-rehmi ki hai ya sadqa diya hai aur koi achha kaam kiya hai toh Allah Ta'ala us ka badla us ke maal mein us ki aulad mein us ki sehat mein aur aisi hi aur cheezon mein ata farmata hai.

Hum ne phir poocha aur aakhirat mein kya milta hai? Farmaya bade darje se kam darje ka azaab, phir aap ne (اَدْخِلُوْٓا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ اَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ) (Surah Al-Ghafir: 46) padhi. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Auza'i R.H se ek shakhs ne poocha ke zara hamein yeh batao hum dekhte hain ke bahut se mufeed parindon ka ghol ka ghol samundar se nikalta hai aur us ke maghribi kinare udta hua, subh ke waqt jata hai. Is qadar ziyadati ke sath ke un ki tadaad koi gin nahin sakta. Shaam ke waqt aisa hi jhund ka jhund wapas aata hai lekin us waqt un ke rang bilkul siyah hote hain. Aap ne farmaya tum ne ise khoob maloom kar liya. In parindon ke qalib mein Aal-e-Firaun ki roohein hain. Jo subh shaam aag ke samne pesh ki jati hain phir apne ghonslon ki taraf laut jati hain, un ke par jal gaye hue hote hain aur yeh siyah ho jate hain. Phir raat ko woh ug jate hain aur siyah jhad jate hain. Phir woh apne ghonslon ki taraf laut jate hain, yahi halat un ki duniya mein hai aur Qayamat ke din un se Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga is Aal-e-Firaun ko sakht azaabon mein dakhil kar do. Kehte hain ke un ki tadaad chhe lakh ki hai jo Firauni fauj thi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke tum mein se jab kabhi koi marta hai har subh shaam us ki jagah us ke samne pesh ki jati hai agar woh Jannati hai to Jannat, aur agar woh Jahannami hai to Jahannam aur kaha jata hai ke teri asal jagah yeh hai jahan tujhe Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din bheje ga. Yeh hadith Sahih Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai.

Aalam-e-Barzakh mein azaab par daleel. Qaum-e-Firaun ka momin mard apna wa'az jaari rakhte hue kehta hai ke yeh kya baat hai ke main tumhein tauheed ki taraf yani Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki ibadat ki taraf bula raha hoon. Main tumhein Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq karne ki dawat de raha hoon. Aur tum mujhe kufr-o-shirk ki taraf bula rahe ho? Tum chahte ho ke main jahil ban jaaun aur be-daleel Allah aur uske Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khilaf karoon? Ghaur karo ke tumhari aur meri dawat mein kis qadar farq hai? Main tumhein us Allah ki taraf le jana chahta hoon jo badi izzat aur kibriyai wala hai. Bawajood iske woh har us shakhs ki tauba qabool karta hai jo uski taraf jhuke aur istighfar kare, lajaram ke ma'ani haq-o-sadaqat ke hain, yani yeh yaqeeni sach aur haq hai ke jis ki taraf tum mujhe bula rahe ho yani buton aur siwaye Allah ke dusron ki ibadat ki taraf yeh toh woh hain jinhein deen-o-duniya ka koi ikhtiyar nahin. Jinhein nafa nuqsan par koi qabu nahin jo apne pukarne wale ki pukaar ko sun sakein toh qabool kar sakein na yahan na wahan. Jaise farman-e-Allah hai (Wa man adallu mimman yad'u min dunillahi mal la yastajibu lahu ila yaumil qiyamati wa hum an du'aihim ghafilun) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 5), yani is se badh kar koi gumrah nahin jo Allah ke siwa auron ko pukarta hai. Jo uski pukaar ko qayamat tak sun nahin sakte. Jinhein mutlaq khabar nahin ke kaun hamein pukaar raha hai? Jo qayamat ke din apne pukarne walon ke dushman ho jayenge aur unki ibadat se bilkul inkar kar jayenge. Go tum unhein pukara karo lekin woh nahin sunte. Aur bilfarz agar sun bhi lein toh qabool nahin kar sakte. Momin-e-Aal-e-Firaun kehta hai, ke hum sab ko laut kar Allah hi ke paas jana hai. Wahan har ek ko apne a'maal ka badla bhugatna hai. Wahan had se guzar jane wale Allah ke sath dusron ko shareek karne wale hamesha ke liye jahannam wasil kar diye jayenge, go tum is waqt meri baton ki qadr na karo. Lekin abhi abhi tumhein maloom ho jayega meri baton ki sadaqat-o-haqqaniyat tum par wazeh ho jayegi. Us waqt nidamat, hasrat aur afsos karoge lekin woh mehez be-sud hoga. Main toh apna kaam Allah ke supurd karta hoon. Mera tawakkul usi ki zaat par hai. Main toh apne har kaam mein usi se madad talab karta hoon. Mujhe tum se koi wasta nahin main tum se alag hoon aur tumhare kamon se nafrat karta hoon. Mera tumhara koi ta'alluq nahin. Allah apne bandon ke tamam halaat se dana-o-beena hai. Mustahiq-e-hidayat jo hain unki woh rehnumai karega aur mustahiqeen-e-zalalat is rehnumai se mehroom rahenge, uska har kaam hikmat wala aur uski har tadbeer achhai wali hai. Is momin ko Allah Ta'ala ne Firauniyon ke makr se bacha liya. Duniya mein bhi woh mehfooz raha yani Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke sath usne nijat payi aur aakhirat ke azaab se bhi mehfooz raha. Baqi tamam Firauni badtareen azaab ka shikar hue. Sab darya mein dubo diye gaye, phir wahan se jahannam wasil kar diye gaye.

Har subh-o-sham un ki roohein jahannam ke samne layi jati hain, Qayamat tak yeh azab unhein hota rahega. Aur Qayamat ke din un ki roohein jism samet jahannam mein daal di jayengi. Aur us din un se kaha jayega ke ae Aal-e-Firaun sakht dard-naak aur bahut zyada takleef-deh azab mein chale jao. Yeh aayat Ahl-e-Sunnat ke us mazhab ki ke Aalam-e-Barzakh mein yani qabron mein azab hota hai bahut badi daleel hai, han yahan yeh baat yaad rakhni chahiye ke baaz ahadees mein kuch aise mazameen warid hue hain jin se maloom hota hai ke azab-e-barzakh ka ilm Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Madine Sharif ki hijrat ke baad hua aur yeh aayat Makka Sharif mein nazil hui hai. Toh jawab is ka yeh hai ke aayat se sirf itna maloom hota hai ke mushrikon ki roohein subh-o-sham jahannam ke samne pesh ki jati hain. Baqi rahi baat ke yeh azab har waqt jaari aur baqi rehta hai ya nahin? Aur yeh bhi ke aaya yeh azab sirf rooh ko hi hota hai ya jism ko bhi, is ka ilm Allah ki taraf se Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Madine Sharif mein karaya gaya. Aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ise bayan farma diya. Pas hadees-o-Quran mila kar masla yeh hua ke azab-o-sawab-e-qabr, rooh aur jism dono ko hota hai aur yahi haq hai. Ab in ahadees ko mulahiza farmaiye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek Yahudiya aurat Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ki khidmat-guzar thi. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) jab kabhi us ke sath kuch sulook karti toh woh dua deti aur kehti Allah tujhe jahannam ke azab se bachaye. Ek roz Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya Qayamat se pehle qabr mein bhi azab hota hai? Aur woh toh us se zyada jhoot Allah par bandha karte hain. Qayamat se pehle koi azab nahin. Kuch hi din guzre the ke ek martaba Zohar ke waqt kapda lapete hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye aankhein surkh ho rahi thin aur ba-awaz-e-buland farma rahe the qabr manind siyah raat ki andheriyon ke tukdon ke hai. Logo agar tum woh jante jo main janta hoon toh bahut zyada rote aur bahut kam hanste, logo! Qabr ke azab se Allah ki panah talab karo, yaqeen mano ke azab-e-qabr haq hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek Yahudiya aurat ne Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se kuch manga jo Aap (R.A) ne diya aur us ne woh dua di us ke aakhir mein hai ke kuch dinon baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe wahi ki gayi hai ke tumhari aazmaish qabron mein ki jati hai. Pas in ahadees aur aayat mein ek tatbeeq toh woh hai jo oopar bayan hui. Dusri tatbeeq yeh bhi ho sakti hai ke aayat 'yu'razuna' se sirf is qadar sabit hota hai ke kuffar ko Aalam-e-Barzakh mein azab hota hai. Lekin is se yeh lazim nahin aata ke momin ko yahan ke baaz gunahon ki wajah se us ki qabr mein azab hota hai. Yeh sirf hadees-e-sharif se sabit hua. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas ek din Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye us waqt ek Yahudiya aurat mai-sahiba ke paas baithi thi aur keh rahi thi ke kya aap ko maloom hai ke tum log apni qabron mein aazmaye jaoge? Ise sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kanp gaye aur farmaya Yahood hi aazmaye jate hain.

Phir chand dinon baad Aap ne farmaya logo tum sab qabron ke fitna mein daale jaoge. Is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) fitna-e-qabr se panah manga karte the. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke aayat se sirf rooh ke azaab ka suboot milta tha. Is se jism tak is azaab ke pahunchne ka suboot nahin tha. Baad mein bazariya-e-wahi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh maloom karaya gaya ke azaab-e-qabr jism-o-rooh ko hota hai. Chunancha Aap ne phir is se bachao ki dua shuru ki, Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas ek Yahudiya aurat aayi aur us ne kaha azaab-e-qabr se hum Allah ki panah chahte hain is par Siddiqa (R.A) ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke kya qabr mein azaab hota hai? Aap ne farmaya haan azaab-e-qabr bar-haq hai farmati hain is ke baad main ne dekha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) har namaz ke baad azaab-e-qabr se panah manga karte the. Is hadith se toh sabit hota hai ke Aap ne ise sunte hi Yahudiya aurat ki tasdeeq ki. Aur oopar wali ahadees se maloom hota hai ke Aap ne takzeeb ki thi. Donon mein tatbeeq yeh hai ke yeh do waqiye hain pehle waqiye ke waqt chunke wahi se Aap ko maloom nahin hua tha Aap ne inkaar farma diya. Phir maloom ho gaya toh Aap ne iqrar kiya, Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Qabr ke azaab ka zikr bahut si sahih ahadees mein aa chuka hai. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain rehti duniya tak har subh-o-sham Aal-e-Firaun ki roohein jahannam ke samne layi jaati hain aur un se kaha jaata hai ke badkaro tumhari asli jagah yahi hai taake un ke ranj-o-gham barhein un ki zillat-o-tauheen ho. Pas aaj bhi woh azaab mein hi hain. Aur hamesha isi mein rahenge. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ka qaul hai ke shaheedon ki roohein sabz rang ke parindon ke qalib mein hain woh jannat mein jahan kahin chahein chalti phirti hain. Aur mominon ke bachon ki roohein chiriyon ke qalib mein hain aur jahan woh chahein jannat mein chalti rehti hain. Aur arsh tale ki qandeelon mein aaram hasil karti hain. Aur Aal-e-Firaun ki roohein siyah rang parindon ke qalib mein hain. Subh bhi jahannam ke paas jaati hain. Aur sham ko bhi yahi un ka pesh hona hai. Meraj wali lambi riwayat mein hai ke phir mujhe ek bahut bari makhlooq ki taraf le chale jin mein se har ek ka pait misl bahut bare ghar ke tha. Jo Aal-e-Firaun ke paas qaid the. Aur Aal-e-Firaun subh sham aag par laye jaate hain. Aur jis din Qayamat qaim hogi Allah Ta'ala farmayega. In Firauniyon ko sakht tar azaabon mein le jao aur yeh Firauni log nakeel wale oonton ki tarah munh neeche kiye patthar aur darakht par charh rahe hain aur bilkul be-aql-o-shaoor hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jo ehsan kare khwah muslim ho khwah kafir Allah Ta'ala use zaroor badla deta hai hum ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kafir ko kya badla milta hai? Farmaya agar us ne sila-rehmi ki hai ya sadqa diya hai aur koi achha kaam kiya hai toh Allah Ta'ala us ka badla us ke maal mein us ki aulad mein us ki sehat mein aur aisi hi aur cheezon mein ata farmata hai.

Phir maloom ho gaya toh Aap ne iqrar kiya, Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Qabr ke azaab ka zikr bahut si sahih ahadees mein aa chuka hai. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain rehti duniya tak har subh-o-sham Aal-e-Firaun ki roohein jahannam ke samne layi jaati hain aur un se kaha jaata hai ke badkaro tumhari asli jagah yahi hai taake un ke ranj-o-gham barhein un ki zillat-o-tauheen ho. Pas aaj bhi woh azaab mein hi hain. Aur hamesha isi mein rahenge. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ka qaul hai ke shaheedon ki roohein sabz rang ke parindon ke qalib mein hain woh jannat mein jahan kahin chahein chalti phirti hain. Aur mominon ke bachon ki roohein chiriyon ke qalib mein hain aur jahan woh chahein jannat mein chalti rehti hain. Aur arsh tale ki qandeelon mein aaram hasil karti hain. Aur Aal-e-Firaun ki roohein siyah rang parindon ke qalib mein hain. Subh bhi jahannam ke paas jaati hain. Aur sham ko bhi yahi un ka pesh hona hai. Meraj wali lambi riwayat mein hai ke phir mujhe ek bahut bari makhlooq ki taraf le chale jin mein se har ek ka pait misl bahut bare ghar ke tha. Jo Aal-e-Firaun ke paas qaid the. Aur Aal-e-Firaun subh sham aag par laye jaate hain. Aur jis din Qayamat qaim hogi Allah Ta'ala farmayega. In Firauniyon ko sakht tar azaabon mein le jao aur yeh Firauni log nakeel wale oonton ki tarah munh neeche kiye patthar aur darakht par charh rahe hain aur bilkul be-aql-o-shaoor hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jo ehsan kare khwah muslim ho khwah kafir Allah Ta'ala use zaroor badla deta hai hum ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kafir ko kya badla milta hai? Farmaya agar us ne sila-rehmi ki hai ya sadqa diya hai aur koi achha kaam kiya hai toh Allah Ta'ala us ka badla us ke maal mein us ki aulad mein us ki sehat mein aur aisi hi aur cheezon mein ata farmata hai.

Hum ne phir poocha aur aakhirat mein kya milta hai? Farmaya bade darje se kam darje ka azaab, phir aap ne (اَدْخِلُوْٓا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ اَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ) (Surah Al-Ghafir: 46) padhi. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Auza'i R.H se ek shakhs ne poocha ke zara hamein yeh batao hum dekhte hain ke bahut se mufeed parindon ka ghol ka ghol samundar se nikalta hai aur us ke maghribi kinare udta hua, subh ke waqt jata hai. Is qadar ziyadati ke sath ke un ki tadaad koi gin nahin sakta. Shaam ke waqt aisa hi jhund ka jhund wapas aata hai lekin us waqt un ke rang bilkul siyah hote hain. Aap ne farmaya tum ne ise khoob maloom kar liya. In parindon ke qalib mein Aal-e-Firaun ki roohein hain. Jo subh shaam aag ke samne pesh ki jati hain phir apne ghonslon ki taraf laut jati hain, un ke par jal gaye hue hote hain aur yeh siyah ho jate hain. Phir raat ko woh ug jate hain aur siyah jhad jate hain. Phir woh apne ghonslon ki taraf laut jate hain, yahi halat un ki duniya mein hai aur Qayamat ke din un se Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga is Aal-e-Firaun ko sakht azaabon mein dakhil kar do. Kehte hain ke un ki tadaad chhe lakh ki hai jo Firauni fauj thi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke tum mein se jab kabhi koi marta hai har subh shaam us ki jagah us ke samne pesh ki jati hai agar woh Jannati hai to Jannat, aur agar woh Jahannami hai to Jahannam aur kaha jata hai ke teri asal jagah yeh hai jahan tujhe Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din bheje ga. Yeh hadith Sahih Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai.

Aalam-e-Barzakh mein azaab par daleel. Qaum-e-Firaun ka momin mard apna wa'az jaari rakhte hue kehta hai ke yeh kya baat hai ke main tumhein tauheed ki taraf yani Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki ibadat ki taraf bula raha hoon. Main tumhein Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq karne ki dawat de raha hoon. Aur tum mujhe kufr-o-shirk ki taraf bula rahe ho? Tum chahte ho ke main jahil ban jaaun aur be-daleel Allah aur uske Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khilaf karoon? Ghaur karo ke tumhari aur meri dawat mein kis qadar farq hai? Main tumhein us Allah ki taraf le jana chahta hoon jo badi izzat aur kibriyai wala hai. Bawajood iske woh har us shakhs ki tauba qabool karta hai jo uski taraf jhuke aur istighfar kare, lajaram ke ma'ani haq-o-sadaqat ke hain, yani yeh yaqeeni sach aur haq hai ke jis ki taraf tum mujhe bula rahe ho yani buton aur siwaye Allah ke dusron ki ibadat ki taraf yeh toh woh hain jinhein deen-o-duniya ka koi ikhtiyar nahin. Jinhein nafa nuqsan par koi qabu nahin jo apne pukarne wale ki pukaar ko sun sakein toh qabool kar sakein na yahan na wahan. Jaise farman-e-Allah hai (Wa man adallu mimman yad'u min dunillahi mal la yastajibu lahu ila yaumil qiyamati wa hum an du'aihim ghafilun) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 5), yani is se badh kar koi gumrah nahin jo Allah ke siwa auron ko pukarta hai. Jo uski pukaar ko qayamat tak sun nahin sakte. Jinhein mutlaq khabar nahin ke kaun hamein pukaar raha hai? Jo qayamat ke din apne pukarne walon ke dushman ho jayenge aur unki ibadat se bilkul inkar kar jayenge. Go tum unhein pukara karo lekin woh nahin sunte. Aur bilfarz agar sun bhi lein toh qabool nahin kar sakte. Momin-e-Aal-e-Firaun kehta hai, ke hum sab ko laut kar Allah hi ke paas jana hai. Wahan har ek ko apne a'maal ka badla bhugatna hai. Wahan had se guzar jane wale Allah ke sath dusron ko shareek karne wale hamesha ke liye jahannam wasil kar diye jayenge, go tum is waqt meri baton ki qadr na karo. Lekin abhi abhi tumhein maloom ho jayega meri baton ki sadaqat-o-haqqaniyat tum par wazeh ho jayegi. Us waqt nidamat, hasrat aur afsos karoge lekin woh mehez be-sud hoga. Main toh apna kaam Allah ke supurd karta hoon. Mera tawakkul usi ki zaat par hai. Main toh apne har kaam mein usi se madad talab karta hoon. Mujhe tum se koi wasta nahin main tum se alag hoon aur tumhare kamon se nafrat karta hoon. Mera tumhara koi ta'alluq nahin. Allah apne bandon ke tamam halaat se dana-o-beena hai. Mustahiq-e-hidayat jo hain unki woh rehnumai karega aur mustahiqeen-e-zalalat is rehnumai se mehroom rahenge, uska har kaam hikmat wala aur uski har tadbeer achhai wali hai. Is momin ko Allah Ta'ala ne Firauniyon ke makr se bacha liya. Duniya mein bhi woh mehfooz raha yani Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke sath usne nijat payi aur aakhirat ke azaab se bhi mehfooz raha. Baqi tamam Firauni badtareen azaab ka shikar hue. Sab darya mein dubo diye gaye, phir wahan se jahannam wasil kar diye gaye.

Har subh-o-sham un ki roohein jahannam ke samne layi jati hain, Qayamat tak yeh azab unhein hota rahega. Aur Qayamat ke din un ki roohein jism samet jahannam mein daal di jayengi. Aur us din un se kaha jayega ke ae Aal-e-Firaun sakht dard-naak aur bahut zyada takleef-deh azab mein chale jao. Yeh aayat Ahl-e-Sunnat ke us mazhab ki ke Aalam-e-Barzakh mein yani qabron mein azab hota hai bahut badi daleel hai, han yahan yeh baat yaad rakhni chahiye ke baaz ahadees mein kuch aise mazameen warid hue hain jin se maloom hota hai ke azab-e-barzakh ka ilm Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Madine Sharif ki hijrat ke baad hua aur yeh aayat Makka Sharif mein nazil hui hai. Toh jawab is ka yeh hai ke aayat se sirf itna maloom hota hai ke mushrikon ki roohein subh-o-sham jahannam ke samne pesh ki jati hain. Baqi rahi baat ke yeh azab har waqt jaari aur baqi rehta hai ya nahin? Aur yeh bhi ke aaya yeh azab sirf rooh ko hi hota hai ya jism ko bhi, is ka ilm Allah ki taraf se Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Madine Sharif mein karaya gaya. Aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ise bayan farma diya. Pas hadees-o-Quran mila kar masla yeh hua ke azab-o-sawab-e-qabr, rooh aur jism dono ko hota hai aur yahi haq hai. Ab in ahadees ko mulahiza farmaiye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek Yahudiya aurat Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ki khidmat-guzar thi. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) jab kabhi us ke sath kuch sulook karti toh woh dua deti aur kehti Allah tujhe jahannam ke azab se bachaye. Ek roz Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya Qayamat se pehle qabr mein bhi azab hota hai? Aur woh toh us se zyada jhoot Allah par bandha karte hain. Qayamat se pehle koi azab nahin. Kuch hi din guzre the ke ek martaba Zohar ke waqt kapda lapete hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye aankhein surkh ho rahi thin aur ba-awaz-e-buland farma rahe the qabr manind siyah raat ki andheriyon ke tukdon ke hai. Logo agar tum woh jante jo main janta hoon toh bahut zyada rote aur bahut kam hanste, logo! Qabr ke azab se Allah ki panah talab karo, yaqeen mano ke azab-e-qabr haq hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek Yahudiya aurat ne Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se kuch manga jo Aap (R.A) ne diya aur us ne woh dua di us ke aakhir mein hai ke kuch dinon baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe wahi ki gayi hai ke tumhari aazmaish qabron mein ki jati hai. Pas in ahadees aur aayat mein ek tatbeeq toh woh hai jo oopar bayan hui. Dusri tatbeeq yeh bhi ho sakti hai ke aayat 'yu'razuna' se sirf is qadar sabit hota hai ke kuffar ko Aalam-e-Barzakh mein azab hota hai. Lekin is se yeh lazim nahin aata ke momin ko yahan ke baaz gunahon ki wajah se us ki qabr mein azab hota hai. Yeh sirf hadees-e-sharif se sabit hua. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas ek din Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye us waqt ek Yahudiya aurat mai-sahiba ke paas baithi thi aur keh rahi thi ke kya aap ko maloom hai ke tum log apni qabron mein aazmaye jaoge? Ise sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kanp gaye aur farmaya Yahood hi aazmaye jate hain.

Phir chand dinon baad Aap ne farmaya logo tum sab qabron ke fitna mein daale jaoge. Is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) fitna-e-qabr se panah manga karte the. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke aayat se sirf rooh ke azaab ka suboot milta tha. Is se jism tak is azaab ke pahunchne ka suboot nahin tha. Baad mein bazariya-e-wahi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh maloom karaya gaya ke azaab-e-qabr jism-o-rooh ko hota hai. Chunancha Aap ne phir is se bachao ki dua shuru ki, Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam.
