Ek roz Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya Qayamat se pehle qabr mein bhi azab hota hai? Aur woh toh us se zyada jhoot Allah par bandha karte hain. Qayamat se pehle koi azab nahin. Kuch hi din guzre the ke ek martaba Zohar ke waqt kapda lapete hue Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tashreef laye aankhein surkh ho rahi thin aur ba-awaz-e-buland farma rahe the qabr manind siyah raat ki andheriyon ke tukdon ke hai. Logo agar tum woh jante jo main janta hoon toh bahut zyada rote aur bahut kam hanste, logo! Qabr ke azab se Allah ki panah talab karo, yaqeen mano ke azab-e-qabr haq hai. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek Yahudiya aurat ne Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) se kuch manga jo Aap (R.A) ne diya aur us ne woh dua di us ke aakhir mein hai ke kuch dinon baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe wahi ki gayi hai ke tumhari aazmaish qabron mein ki jati hai. Pas in ahadees aur aayat mein ek tatbeeq toh woh hai jo oopar bayan hui. Dusri tatbeeq yeh bhi ho sakti hai ke aayat 'yu'razuna' se sirf is qadar sabit hota hai ke kuffar ko Aalam-e-Barzakh mein azab hota hai. Lekin is se yeh lazim nahin aata ke momin ko yahan ke baaz gunahon ki wajah se us ki qabr mein azab hota hai. Yeh sirf hadees-e-sharif se sabit hua. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas ek din Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aaye us waqt ek Yahudiya aurat mai-sahiba ke paas baithi thi aur keh rahi thi ke kya aap ko maloom hai ke tum log apni qabron mein aazmaye jaoge? Ise sun kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kanp gaye aur farmaya Yahood hi aazmaye jate hain.

Phir chand dinon baad Aap ne farmaya logo tum sab qabron ke fitna mein daale jaoge. Is ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) fitna-e-qabr se panah manga karte the. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke aayat se sirf rooh ke azaab ka suboot milta tha. Is se jism tak is azaab ke pahunchne ka suboot nahin tha. Baad mein bazariya-e-wahi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh maloom karaya gaya ke azaab-e-qabr jism-o-rooh ko hota hai. Chunancha Aap ne phir is se bachao ki dua shuru ki, Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) ke paas ek Yahudiya aurat aayi aur us ne kaha azaab-e-qabr se hum Allah ki panah chahte hain is par Siddiqa (R.A) ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal kiya ke kya qabr mein azaab hota hai? Aap ne farmaya haan azaab-e-qabr bar-haq hai farmati hain is ke baad main ne dekha ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) har namaz ke baad azaab-e-qabr se panah manga karte the. Is hadith se toh sabit hota hai ke Aap ne ise sunte hi Yahudiya aurat ki tasdeeq ki. Aur oopar wali ahadees se maloom hota hai ke Aap ne takzeeb ki thi. Donon mein tatbeeq yeh hai ke yeh do waqiye hain pehle waqiye ke waqt chunke wahi se Aap ko maloom nahin hua tha Aap ne inkaar farma diya. Phir maloom ho gaya toh Aap ne iqrar kiya, Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Qabr ke azaab ka zikr bahut si sahih ahadees mein aa chuka hai. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Qatada (R.H) farmate hain rehti duniya tak har subh-o-sham Aal-e-Firaun ki roohein jahannam ke samne layi jaati hain aur un se kaha jaata hai ke badkaro tumhari asli jagah yahi hai taake un ke ranj-o-gham barhein un ki zillat-o-tauheen ho. Pas aaj bhi woh azaab mein hi hain. Aur hamesha isi mein rahenge. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ka qaul hai ke shaheedon ki roohein sabz rang ke parindon ke qalib mein hain woh jannat mein jahan kahin chahein chalti phirti hain. Aur mominon ke bachon ki roohein chiriyon ke qalib mein hain aur jahan woh chahein jannat mein chalti rehti hain. Aur arsh tale ki qandeelon mein aaram hasil karti hain. Aur Aal-e-Firaun ki roohein siyah rang parindon ke qalib mein hain. Subh bhi jahannam ke paas jaati hain. Aur sham ko bhi yahi un ka pesh hona hai. Meraj wali lambi riwayat mein hai ke phir mujhe ek bahut bari makhlooq ki taraf le chale jin mein se har ek ka pait misl bahut bare ghar ke tha. Jo Aal-e-Firaun ke paas qaid the. Aur Aal-e-Firaun subh sham aag par laye jaate hain. Aur jis din Qayamat qaim hogi Allah Ta'ala farmayega. In Firauniyon ko sakht tar azaabon mein le jao aur yeh Firauni log nakeel wale oonton ki tarah munh neeche kiye patthar aur darakht par charh rahe hain aur bilkul be-aql-o-shaoor hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke jo ehsan kare khwah muslim ho khwah kafir Allah Ta'ala use zaroor badla deta hai hum ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kafir ko kya badla milta hai? Farmaya agar us ne sila-rehmi ki hai ya sadqa diya hai aur koi achha kaam kiya hai toh Allah Ta'ala us ka badla us ke maal mein us ki aulad mein us ki sehat mein aur aisi hi aur cheezon mein ata farmata hai.

Hum ne phir poocha aur aakhirat mein kya milta hai? Farmaya bade darje se kam darje ka azaab, phir aap ne (اَدْخِلُوْٓا اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ اَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ) (Surah Al-Ghafir: 46) padhi. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Hazrat Auza'i R.H se ek shakhs ne poocha ke zara hamein yeh batao hum dekhte hain ke bahut se mufeed parindon ka ghol ka ghol samundar se nikalta hai aur us ke maghribi kinare udta hua, subh ke waqt jata hai. Is qadar ziyadati ke sath ke un ki tadaad koi gin nahin sakta. Shaam ke waqt aisa hi jhund ka jhund wapas aata hai lekin us waqt un ke rang bilkul siyah hote hain. Aap ne farmaya tum ne ise khoob maloom kar liya. In parindon ke qalib mein Aal-e-Firaun ki roohein hain. Jo subh shaam aag ke samne pesh ki jati hain phir apne ghonslon ki taraf laut jati hain, un ke par jal gaye hue hote hain aur yeh siyah ho jate hain. Phir raat ko woh ug jate hain aur siyah jhad jate hain. Phir woh apne ghonslon ki taraf laut jate hain, yahi halat un ki duniya mein hai aur Qayamat ke din un se Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga is Aal-e-Firaun ko sakht azaabon mein dakhil kar do. Kehte hain ke un ki tadaad chhe lakh ki hai jo Firauni fauj thi. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke tum mein se jab kabhi koi marta hai har subh shaam us ki jagah us ke samne pesh ki jati hai agar woh Jannati hai to Jannat, aur agar woh Jahannami hai to Jahannam aur kaha jata hai ke teri asal jagah yeh hai jahan tujhe Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din bheje ga. Yeh hadith Sahih Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai.

Aalam-e-Barzakh mein azaab par daleel. Qaum-e-Firaun ka momin mard apna wa'az jaari rakhte hue kehta hai ke yeh kya baat hai ke main tumhein tauheed ki taraf yani Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki ibadat ki taraf bula raha hoon. Main tumhein Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki tasdeeq karne ki dawat de raha hoon. Aur tum mujhe kufr-o-shirk ki taraf bula rahe ho? Tum chahte ho ke main jahil ban jaaun aur be-daleel Allah aur uske Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khilaf karoon? Ghaur karo ke tumhari aur meri dawat mein kis qadar farq hai? Main tumhein us Allah ki taraf le jana chahta hoon jo badi izzat aur kibriyai wala hai. Bawajood iske woh har us shakhs ki tauba qabool karta hai jo uski taraf jhuke aur istighfar kare, lajaram ke ma'ani haq-o-sadaqat ke hain, yani yeh yaqeeni sach aur haq hai ke jis ki taraf tum mujhe bula rahe ho yani buton aur siwaye Allah ke dusron ki ibadat ki taraf yeh toh woh hain jinhein deen-o-duniya ka koi ikhtiyar nahin. Jinhein nafa nuqsan par koi qabu nahin jo apne pukarne wale ki pukaar ko sun sakein toh qabool kar sakein na yahan na wahan. Jaise farman-e-Allah hai (Wa man adallu mimman yad'u min dunillahi mal la yastajibu lahu ila yaumil qiyamati wa hum an du'aihim ghafilun) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 5), yani is se badh kar koi gumrah nahin jo Allah ke siwa auron ko pukarta hai. Jo uski pukaar ko qayamat tak sun nahin sakte. Jinhein mutlaq khabar nahin ke kaun hamein pukaar raha hai? Jo qayamat ke din apne pukarne walon ke dushman ho jayenge aur unki ibadat se bilkul inkar kar jayenge. Go tum unhein pukara karo lekin woh nahin sunte. Aur bilfarz agar sun bhi lein toh qabool nahin kar sakte. Momin-e-Aal-e-Firaun kehta hai, ke hum sab ko laut kar Allah hi ke paas jana hai. Wahan har ek ko apne a'maal ka badla bhugatna hai. Wahan had se guzar jane wale Allah ke sath dusron ko shareek karne wale hamesha ke liye jahannam wasil kar diye jayenge, go tum is waqt meri baton ki qadr na karo. Lekin abhi abhi tumhein maloom ho jayega meri baton ki sadaqat-o-haqqaniyat tum par wazeh ho jayegi. Us waqt nidamat, hasrat aur afsos karoge lekin woh mehez be-sud hoga. Main toh apna kaam Allah ke supurd karta hoon. Mera tawakkul usi ki zaat par hai. Main toh apne har kaam mein usi se madad talab karta hoon. Mujhe tum se koi wasta nahin main tum se alag hoon aur tumhare kamon se nafrat karta hoon. Mera tumhara koi ta'alluq nahin. Allah apne bandon ke tamam halaat se dana-o-beena hai. Mustahiq-e-hidayat jo hain unki woh rehnumai karega aur mustahiqeen-e-zalalat is rehnumai se mehroom rahenge, uska har kaam hikmat wala aur uski har tadbeer achhai wali hai. Is momin ko Allah Ta'ala ne Firauniyon ke makr se bacha liya. Duniya mein bhi woh mehfooz raha yani Musa (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ke sath usne nijat payi aur aakhirat ke azaab se bhi mehfooz raha. Baqi tamam Firauni badtareen azaab ka shikar hue. Sab darya mein dubo diye gaye, phir wahan se jahannam wasil kar diye gaye.

Har subh-o-sham un ki roohein jahannam ke samne layi jati hain, Qayamat tak yeh azab unhein hota rahega. Aur Qayamat ke din un ki roohein jism samet jahannam mein daal di jayengi. Aur us din un se kaha jayega ke ae Aal-e-Firaun sakht dard-naak aur bahut zyada takleef-deh azab mein chale jao. Yeh aayat Ahl-e-Sunnat ke us mazhab ki ke Aalam-e-Barzakh mein yani qabron mein azab hota hai bahut badi daleel hai, han yahan yeh baat yaad rakhni chahiye ke baaz ahadees mein kuch aise mazameen warid hue hain jin se maloom hota hai ke azab-e-barzakh ka ilm Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Madine Sharif ki hijrat ke baad hua aur yeh aayat Makka Sharif mein nazil hui hai. Toh jawab is ka yeh hai ke aayat se sirf itna maloom hota hai ke mushrikon ki roohein subh-o-sham jahannam ke samne pesh ki jati hain. Baqi rahi baat ke yeh azab har waqt jaari aur baqi rehta hai ya nahin? Aur yeh bhi ke aaya yeh azab sirf rooh ko hi hota hai ya jism ko bhi, is ka ilm Allah ki taraf se Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko Madine Sharif mein karaya gaya. Dozakhiyon ke liye ek aur azab. Jahannami log jahannam ke aur azabon ko bardasht karte hue ek aur azab ke bhi shikar honge jiska bayan yahan ho raha hai. Yeh azab Firaun ko bhi hoga aur dusre dozakhiyon ko bhi yani aapas mein thukna, tazleel aur ladai jhagde. Chote badon se yani tabedari karne aur hukm-e-ahkam ke manne wale jin ki badai aur buzurgi ke qail the aur jin ki baatein tasleem kiya karte the aur jin ke kahe hue par aamil the un se kahenge. Ke duniya mein hum toh aap ke tabe-e-farman rahe. Jo aap ne kaha hum baja late. Kufr aur gumrahi ke ahkam bhi jo aap ki bargah se sadir hue aap ke taqaddus aur ilm-o-fazl, sardari aur hukumat ki bina par hum sab ko mante rahe, ab yahan aap hamein kuch toh kaam aayein. Hamare azabon ka hi koi hissa apne upar utha lijiye, yeh ruasa aur umra, sadat aur buzurg jawab denge ke hum bhi toh tumhare sath jal bhun rahe hain. Hamein jo azab ho rahe hain woh kya kam hain jo hum tumhare azab uthayen? Allah Ta'ala ka hukm jari ho chuka hai. Rabb faisle sadir farma chuka hai. Har ek ko us ke bad-aamal ke mutabiq saza de chuka hai. Ab is mein kami namumkin hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai har ek ke liye badha chadha azab go tum na samjho. Jab ahl-e-dozakh samajh lenge ke Allah Ta'ala un ki dua qabool nahin farma raha balkeh kaan bhi nahin lagata. Balkeh unhein daant diya hai aur farma chuka hai ke yahin pade raho aur mujh se kalam bhi na karo toh woh jahannam ke darogon se kahenge. Jo wahan ke aise hi pasban hain jaise duniya ke jail khanon ke nigahban daroge aur muhafiz sipah hote hain. Un se kahenge ke tum hi zara Allah Ta'ala se dua karo ke kisi ek din hi woh hamare azab halke kar de, woh unhein jawab denge ke kya rasoolon ki zabani ahkam-e-rabbani duniya mein tumhein pahunche na the? Yeh kahenge haan pahunche the. Toh farishte kahenge phir ab tum aap hi Allah Ta'ala se keh sun lo. Hum toh tumhari taraf se koi arz us ki janab mein kar nahin sakte. Balkeh hum khud tum se bezar aur tumhare dushman hain suno hum tumhein keh dete hain ke khwah tum dua karo khwah tumhare liye aur koi dua kare namumkin hai ke tumhare azabon mein kami ho. Kafiron ki dua namaqbool aur mardood hai.

Dozakhiyon ke liye ek aur azab. Jahannami log jahannam ke aur azabon ko bardasht karte hue ek aur azab ke bhi shikar honge jiska bayan yahan ho raha hai. Yeh azab Firaun ko bhi hoga aur dusre dozakhiyon ko bhi yani aapas mein thukna, tazleel aur ladai jhagde. Chote badon se yani tabedari karne aur hukm-e-ahkam ke manne wale jin ki badai aur buzurgi ke qail the aur jin ki baatein tasleem kiya karte the aur jin ke kahe hue par aamil the un se kahenge. Ke duniya mein hum toh aap ke tabe-e-farman rahe. Jo aap ne kaha hum baja late. Kufr aur gumrahi ke ahkam bhi jo aap ki bargah se sadir hue aap ke taqaddus aur ilm-o-fazl, sardari aur hukumat ki bina par hum sab ko mante rahe, ab yahan aap hamein kuch toh kaam aayein. Hamare azabon ka hi koi hissa apne upar utha lijiye, yeh ruasa aur umra, sadat aur buzurg jawab denge ke hum bhi toh tumhare sath jal bhun rahe hain. Hamein jo azab ho rahe hain woh kya kam hain jo hum tumhare azab uthayen? Allah Ta'ala ka hukm jari ho chuka hai. Rabb faisle sadir farma chuka hai. Har ek ko us ke bad-aamal ke mutabiq saza de chuka hai. Ab is mein kami namumkin hai. Jaise aur aayat mein hai har ek ke liye badha chadha azab go tum na samjho. Jab ahl-e-dozakh samajh lenge ke Allah Ta'ala un ki dua qabool nahin farma raha balkeh kaan bhi nahin lagata. Rasoolon aur Ahl-e-Iman ko duniya-o-akhirat mein madad ki basharat. Ayat mein rasoolon ki madad karne ka Allah ka wada hai, phir hum dekhte hain ke baaz rasoolon ko un ki qomon ne qatl kar diya, jaise Hazrat Yahya A.S, Hazrat Zakariya A.S, Hazrat Shoaib A.S, salawatullahi alaihim wa salamuhu, aur baaz ambiya ko apna watan chhorna para, jaise Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah Alaihis Salam. Aur Hazrat Isa A.S ke unhein Allah Ta'ala ne aasman ki taraf hijrat karayi. Phir kya koi nahin keh sakta ke yeh wada pura kyun nahin hua? Is ke do jawab hain; ek toh yeh ke yahan go aam khabar hai lekin murad baaz se hai, aur yeh lughat mein umooman paya jata hai ke mutlaq zikr ho aur murad khaas afraad hon. Dusre yeh ke madad karne se murad badla lena ho. Pas koi nabi aisa nahin guzra jise eeza pahunchane walon se qudrat ne zabardast inteqam na liya ho. Chunancha Hazrat Yahya A.S, Hazrat Zakariya A.S, Hazrat Shoaib A.S ke qatilon par Allah ne un ke dushmanon ko musallat kar diya aur unhon ne unhein zer-o-zabar kar dala, un ke khoon ki nadiyan baha dein aur unhein nihayat zillat ke sath maut ke ghaat utara. Namrood mardood ka mashhoor waqia duniya jaanti hai ke qudrat ne use kaisi pakar mein pakra? Hazrat Isa A.S ko jin yahudiyon ne sooli dene ki koshish ki thi, un par Janab-e-Bari Aziz-o-Hakim ne roomiyon ko ghalib kar diya aur un ke hathon un ki sakht zillat-o-ihanat hui. Aur abhi qayamat ke qareeb jab Aap (ﷺ) utrenge tab Dajjal ke sath un yahudiyon ki jo us ke lashkari honge qatl karenge. Aur Imam-e-Adil aur hakim-e-ba-insaf ban kar tashreef layenge, saleeb ko todenge, khanzeer ko qatl karenge aur jizya batil kar denge, bajuz Islam ke aur kuch qabool na farmayenge. Yeh hai Allah Ta'ala ki azeem-ush-shan madad aur yahi dastoor-e-qudrat hai jo pehle se hai aur ab tak jaari hai ke woh apne momin bandon ki dunyawi imdad bhi farmata hai aur un ke dushmanon se khud inteqam le kar un ki aankhein thandi karta hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal ne farmaya hai jo shakhs mere nabiyon se dushmani kare us ne mujhe larai ke liye talab kiya. Dusri hadith mein hai main apne doston ki taraf se badla zaroor le liya karta hoon jaise ke sher badla leta hai. Isi bina par is Malik-ul-Mulk ne qom-e-Nuh se, Aad se, Thamudiyon se, Ashab-ur-Rass se, qom-e-Loot se, Ahl-e-Madyan se aur un jaise un tamam logon se jinhon ne Allah ke rasoolon ko jhutlaya tha aur haq ka khilaf kiya tha badla liya. Ek ek ko chun chun kar tabah-o-barbad kiya aur jitne momin un mein the un sab ko bacha liya. Imam Suddi farmate hain jis qom mein Allah ke rasool A.S aaye ya iman dar bande unhein paigham-e-ilahi pahunchane ke liye khare hue aur us qom ne un nabiyon ki ya un mominon ki be-hurmati ki aur unhein mara peeta qatl kiya, zaroor bil-zaroor usi zamane mein azab-e-ilahi un par baras pare. Nabiyon ke qatl ke badle lene wale uth khare hue aur pani ki tarah un ke khoon se pyasi zameen ko sairab kiya.

Pas go Anbiya aur Momineen yahan qatl kiye gaye lekin un ka khoon rang laya aur un ke dushmanon ka bhus ki tarah bharkas nikal diya. Namumkin hai ke aise bandagan-e-khas ki imdad-o-ianat na ho aur un ke dushmanon se poora inteqam na liya gaya ho. Ashraf-ul-Anbiya Habibullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke halat-e-zindagi duniya aur duniya walon ke samne hain ke Allah ne Aap ko aur Aap ke Sahaba ko ghalba diya aur dushmanon ki tamam tar koshishon ko be-natija rakha. In tamam par Aap ko khula ghalba ata farmaya. Aap ke kalme ko buland-o-bala kiya, Aap ka deen duniya ke tamam adyan par chha gaya. Qaum ki zabardast mukhalifaton ke waqt apne Nabi ko Madine pahuncha diya aur Madine walon ko saccha jaan-nisar bana kar phir mushrikeen ka sara zor Badr ki ladai mein dha diya. Un ke kufr ke tamam wazni sutoon is ladai mein ukhed diye. Sardaran-e-mushrik ya to tukde tukde kar diye gaye ya Musalmanon ke hathon mein qaidi ban kar namuradi ke sath gardan jhukaye nazar aane lage. Qaid-o-band mein jakde hue zillat-o-ihanat ke sath Madine ki galiyon mein kisi ke hathon par aur kisi ke paon par dusre ki giraft thi. Allah ki hikmat ne un par phir ehsan kiya aur ek martaba phir mauqa diya, fidiya le kar azad kar diye gaye lekin phir bhi jab mukhalifat-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se baz na aaye aur apne kartooton par ade rahe, to woh waqt bhi aaya ke jahan se Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko chup chupa kar raat ke andhere mein pa-piyada hijrat karni padi thi, wahan fatihana haisiyat se dakhil hue aur gardan par hath bandhe dushmanan-e-Rasool samne laye gaye. Aur bilad-e-haram ki azmat-o-izzat Rasool-e-Mohtaram ki wajah se poori hui. Aur tamam shirk-o-kufr aur har tarah ki be-adabiyon se Allah ka ghar pak saf kar diya gaya. Bil-akhir Yaman bhi fatah hua aur poora jazeera-e-Arab qabza-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein aa gaya. Aur jaug ke jaug log Allah ke deen mein dakhil ho gaye. Phir Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne apne Rasool Rahmat-ul-Aalameen ko apni taraf bula liya aur wahan ki karamat-o-azmat se apni mehmandari mein rakh kar nawaza (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Phir Aap ke baad Aap ke nek-nehad Sahaba ko Aap ka janasheen banaya. Jo Muhammadi jhanda liye khade ho gaye aur Allah ki tauheed ki taraf Allah ki makhlooq ko bulane lage. Jo roda rah mein aaya use alag kiya. Jo khar chaman mein nazar pada use kaat dala. Gaon gaon, shehar shehar, mulk mulk dawat-e-Islam pahuncha di, jo mani hua use mana ka maza chakhaya. Isi zimn mein mashriq-o-maghrib mein saltanat-e-Islami phail gayi. Zameen par aur zameen walon ke jismon par hi Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) ne fatah hasil nahin ki balkay un ke dilon par bhi fatah pa li. Islami naqoosh dilon mein jama diye aur sab ko kalma-e-tauheed ke neeche jama kar diya. Deen-e-Muhammadi ne zameen ka chappa chappa aur kona kona apne qabze mein kar liya. Dawat-e-Muhammadiya behre kanon tak bhi pahunch chuki. Sirat-e-Muhammadi andhon ne bhi dekh liya. Allah is pakbaz jamaat ko un ki ulu-ul-azmiyon ka behtareen badla inayat farmaye. Ameen! Alhamdulillah, Allah ka aur us ke Rasool ka kalam maujood hai. Aur aaj tak un ke saron par Rabb ka hath hai.

Aur Qayamat tak yeh watan muzaffar-o-mansoor hi rahega aur jo is ke muqable par aayega munh ki khayega aur phir kabhi munh na dikhayega, yahi matlab hai is mubarak aayat ka. Qayamat ke din bhi deendaron ki madad-o-nusrat hogi aur bahut badi aur bahut aala paimane tak. Gawahon se murad farishtay hain, dusri aayat mein yaum badal hai pehli aayat ke isi lafz se. Baaz qiraton mein yaum hai toh yeh goya pehle yaum ki tafseer hai. Zalimon se murad mushrik hain, un ka uzr-o-fidiya Qayamat ke din maqbool na hoga, woh rahmat-e-Rabb se us din door dhakel diye jayenge. Un ke liye bura ghar yani Jahannam hoga. Un ki aaqibat kharab hogi. Hazrat Musa A.S ko hum ne hidayat-o-noor bakhsha. Bani Israel ka anjam behtar kiya. Firaun ke maal-o-zameen ka unhein waris banaya kyunke yeh Allah ki ita'at aur itteba-e-Rasool mein sabit qadmi ke sath sakhtiyan bardasht karte rahe thay. Jis kitab ke yeh waris hue woh aqalmandon ke liye sartapa ba'is-e-hidayat-o-ibrat thi. Ae Nabi ﷺ aap sabr kijiye, Allah ka wada sacha hai, aap ka hi bol bala hoga, anjam ke lihaz se aap wale hi ghalib rahenge. Rabb apne wade ke khilaf kabhi nahin karta, bila-shak-o-shuba deen Allah ka uncha ho kar hi rahega. Toh apne Rabb se istighfar karta reh. Aap ko hukm de kar darasal aap ki ummat ko istighfar par aamada karna hai. Din ke aakhri aur raat ke intehai waqt khusoosiyat ke sath Rabb ki pakeezgi aur tareef bayan kiya kar. Jo log batil par jam kar haq ko hata dete hain, dalail ko ghalat behas se taal dete hain, un ke dilon mein bajuz takabbur ke aur kuch nahin, un mein itteba-e-haq se sarkashi hai. Yeh Rabb ki baton ki izzat jante hi nahin. Lekin jo takabbur aur jo khudi aur jo apni unchai woh chahte hain woh unhein hargiz hasil nahin hone ki. Un ke maqsood batil hain. Un ke matloob la-hasil hain. Allah ki panah talab kar ke un jaisa haal kisi bhale aadmi ka na ho. Aur in nakhwat pasand logon ki shararat se bhi Allah ki panah chah kar. Yeh aayat Yahudiyon ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Yeh kehte thay Dajjal inhi mein se hoga aur us ke zamane mein yeh zamane ke badshah ho jayenge. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ se farmaya ke fitna-e-Dajjal se Allah ki panah talab kiya karo. Woh Sami-o-Baseer hai. Lekin aayat ko Yahudiyon ke bare mein nazil shuda batana aur Dajjal ki badshahi aur us ke fitne se panah ka hukm, sab cheezein takalluf se pur hain. Mana ke yeh Tafseer Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai magar yeh qaul nudrat se khali nahin. Theek yahi hai ke aam hai. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'alam.

Allah ki hikmat ne un par phir ehsan kiya aur ek martaba phir mauqa diya, fidiya le kar azad kar diye gaye lekin phir bhi jab mukhalifat-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se baz na aaye aur apne kartooton par ade rahe, to woh waqt bhi aaya ke jahan se Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko chup chupa kar raat ke andhere mein pa-piyada hijrat karni padi thi, wahan fatihana haisiyat se dakhil hue aur gardan par hath bandhe dushmanan-e-Rasool samne laye gaye. Aur bilad-e-haram ki azmat-o-izzat Rasool-e-Mohtaram ki wajah se poori hui. Aur tamam shirk-o-kufr aur har tarah ki be-adabiyon se Allah ka ghar pak saf kar diya gaya. Bil-akhir Yaman bhi fatah hua aur poora jazeera-e-Arab qabza-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mein aa gaya. Aur jaug ke jaug log Allah ke deen mein dakhil ho gaye. Phir Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne apne Rasool Rahmat-ul-Aalameen ko apni taraf bula liya aur wahan ki karamat-o-azmat se apni mehmandari mein rakh kar nawaza (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Phir Aap ke baad Aap ke nek-nehad Sahaba ko Aap ka janasheen banaya. Jo Muhammadi jhanda liye khade ho gaye aur Allah ki tauheed ki taraf Allah ki makhlooq ko bulane lage. Jo roda rah mein aaya use alag kiya. Jo khar chaman mein nazar pada use kaat dala. Gaon gaon, shehar shehar, mulk mulk dawat-e-Islam pahuncha di, jo mani hua use mana ka maza chakhaya. Isi zimn mein mashriq-o-maghrib mein saltanat-e-Islami phail gayi. Zameen par aur zameen walon ke jismon par hi Sahaba-e-Kiram (R.A) ne fatah hasil nahin ki balkay un ke dilon par bhi fatah pa li. Islami naqoosh dilon mein jama diye aur sab ko kalma-e-tauheed ke neeche jama kar diya. Deen-e-Muhammadi ne zameen ka chappa chappa aur kona kona apne qabze mein kar liya. Dawat-e-Muhammadiya behre kanon tak bhi pahunch chuki. Sirat-e-Muhammadi andhon ne bhi dekh liya. Allah is pakbaz jamaat ko un ki ulu-ul-azmiyon ka behtareen badla inayat farmaye. Ameen! Alhamdulillah, Allah ka aur us ke Rasool ka kalam maujood hai. Aur aaj tak un ke saron par Rabb ka hath hai.

Aur Qayamat tak yeh watan muzaffar-o-mansoor hi rahega aur jo is ke muqable par aayega munh ki khayega aur phir kabhi munh na dikhayega, yahi matlab hai is mubarak aayat ka. Qayamat ke din bhi deendaron ki madad-o-nusrat hogi aur bahut badi aur bahut aala paimane tak. Gawahon se murad farishtay hain, dusri aayat mein yaum badal hai pehli aayat ke isi lafz se. Baaz qiraton mein yaum hai toh yeh goya pehle yaum ki tafseer hai. Zalimon se murad mushrik hain, un ka uzr-o-fidiya Qayamat ke din maqbool na hoga, woh rahmat-e-Rabb se us din door dhakel diye jayenge. Un ke liye bura ghar yani Jahannam hoga. Un ki aaqibat kharab hogi. Hazrat Musa A.S ko hum ne hidayat-o-noor bakhsha. Bani Israel ka anjam behtar kiya. Firaun ke maal-o-zameen ka unhein waris banaya kyunke yeh Allah ki ita'at aur itteba-e-Rasool mein sabit qadmi ke sath sakhtiyan bardasht karte rahe thay. Jis kitab ke yeh waris hue woh aqalmandon ke liye sartapa ba'is-e-hidayat-o-ibrat thi. Ae Nabi ﷺ aap sabr kijiye, Allah ka wada sacha hai, aap ka hi bol bala hoga, anjam ke lihaz se aap wale hi ghalib rahenge. Rabb apne wade ke khilaf kabhi nahin karta, bila-shak-o-shuba deen Allah ka uncha ho kar hi rahega. Toh apne Rabb se istighfar karta reh. Aap ko hukm de kar darasal aap ki ummat ko istighfar par aamada karna hai. Din ke aakhri aur raat ke intehai waqt khusoosiyat ke sath Rabb ki pakeezgi aur tareef bayan kiya kar. Jo log batil par jam kar haq ko hata dete hain, dalail ko ghalat behas se taal dete hain, un ke dilon mein bajuz takabbur ke aur kuch nahin, un mein itteba-e-haq se sarkashi hai. Yeh Rabb ki baton ki izzat jante hi nahin. Lekin jo takabbur aur jo khudi aur jo apni unchai woh chahte hain woh unhein hargiz hasil nahin hone ki. Un ke maqsood batil hain. Un ke matloob la-hasil hain. Allah ki panah talab kar ke un jaisa haal kisi bhale aadmi ka na ho. Aur in nakhwat pasand logon ki shararat se bhi Allah ki panah chah kar. Yeh aayat Yahudiyon ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Yeh kehte thay Dajjal inhi mein se hoga aur us ke zamane mein yeh zamane ke badshah ho jayenge. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ se farmaya ke fitna-e-Dajjal se Allah ki panah talab kiya karo. Woh Sami-o-Baseer hai. Lekin aayat ko Yahudiyon ke bare mein nazil shuda batana aur Dajjal ki badshahi aur us ke fitne se panah ka hukm, sab cheezein takalluf se pur hain. Mana ke yeh Tafseer Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai magar yeh qaul nudrat se khali nahin. Theek yahi hai ke aam hai. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'alam.

Aur Qayamat tak yeh watan muzaffar-o-mansoor hi rahega aur jo is ke muqable par aayega munh ki khayega aur phir kabhi munh na dikhayega, yahi matlab hai is mubarak aayat ka. Qayamat ke din bhi deendaron ki madad-o-nusrat hogi aur bahut badi aur bahut aala paimane tak. Gawahon se murad farishtay hain, dusri aayat mein yaum badal hai pehli aayat ke isi lafz se. Baaz qiraton mein yaum hai toh yeh goya pehle yaum ki tafseer hai. Zalimon se murad mushrik hain, un ka uzr-o-fidiya Qayamat ke din maqbool na hoga, woh rahmat-e-Rabb se us din door dhakel diye jayenge. Un ke liye bura ghar yani Jahannam hoga. Un ki aaqibat kharab hogi. Hazrat Musa A.S ko hum ne hidayat-o-noor bakhsha. Bani Israel ka anjam behtar kiya. Firaun ke maal-o-zameen ka unhein waris banaya kyunke yeh Allah ki ita'at aur itteba-e-Rasool mein sabit qadmi ke sath sakhtiyan bardasht karte rahe thay. Jis kitab ke yeh waris hue woh aqalmandon ke liye sartapa ba'is-e-hidayat-o-ibrat thi. Ae Nabi ﷺ aap sabr kijiye, Allah ka wada sacha hai, aap ka hi bol bala hoga, anjam ke lihaz se aap wale hi ghalib rahenge. Rabb apne wade ke khilaf kabhi nahin karta, bila-shak-o-shuba deen Allah ka uncha ho kar hi rahega. Toh apne Rabb se istighfar karta reh. Aap ko hukm de kar darasal aap ki ummat ko istighfar par aamada karna hai. Din ke aakhri aur raat ke intehai waqt khusoosiyat ke sath Rabb ki pakeezgi aur tareef bayan kiya kar. Jo log batil par jam kar haq ko hata dete hain, dalail ko ghalat behas se taal dete hain, un ke dilon mein bajuz takabbur ke aur kuch nahin, un mein itteba-e-haq se sarkashi hai. Yeh Rabb ki baton ki izzat jante hi nahin. Lekin jo takabbur aur jo khudi aur jo apni unchai woh chahte hain woh unhein hargiz hasil nahin hone ki. Un ke maqsood batil hain. Un ke matloob la-hasil hain. Allah ki panah talab kar ke un jaisa haal kisi bhale aadmi ka na ho. Aur in nakhwat pasand logon ki shararat se bhi Allah ki panah chah kar. Yeh aayat Yahudiyon ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Yeh kehte thay Dajjal inhi mein se hoga aur us ke zamane mein yeh zamane ke badshah ho jayenge. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ se farmaya ke fitna-e-Dajjal se Allah ki panah talab kiya karo. Woh Sami-o-Baseer hai. Lekin aayat ko Yahudiyon ke bare mein nazil shuda batana aur Dajjal ki badshahi aur us ke fitne se panah ka hukm, sab cheezein takalluf se pur hain. Mana ke yeh Tafseer Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai magar yeh qaul nudrat se khali nahin. Theek yahi hai ke aam hai. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'alam.

Rasoolon aur Ahl-e-Iman ko duniya-o-akhirat mein madad ki basharat. Ayat mein rasoolon ki madad karne ka Allah ka wada hai, phir hum dekhte hain ke baaz rasoolon ko un ki qomon ne qatl kar diya, jaise Hazrat Yahya A.S, Hazrat Zakariya A.S, Hazrat Shoaib A.S, salawatullahi alaihim wa salamuhu, aur baaz ambiya ko apna watan chhorna para, jaise Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah Alaihis Salam. Aur Hazrat Isa A.S ke unhein Allah Ta'ala ne aasman ki taraf hijrat karayi. Phir kya koi nahin keh sakta ke yeh wada pura kyun nahin hua? Is ke do jawab hain; ek toh yeh ke yahan go aam khabar hai lekin murad baaz se hai, aur yeh lughat mein umooman paya jata hai ke mutlaq zikr ho aur murad khaas afraad hon. Dusre yeh ke madad karne se murad badla lena ho. Pas koi nabi aisa nahin guzra jise eeza pahunchane walon se qudrat ne zabardast inteqam na liya ho. Chunancha Hazrat Yahya A.S, Hazrat Zakariya A.S, Hazrat Shoaib A.S ke qatilon par Allah ne un ke dushmanon ko musallat kar diya aur unhon ne unhein zer-o-zabar kar dala, un ke khoon ki nadiyan baha dein aur unhein nihayat zillat ke sath maut ke ghaat utara. Namrood mardood ka mashhoor waqia duniya jaanti hai ke qudrat ne use kaisi pakar mein pakra? Hazrat Isa A.S ko jin yahudiyon ne sooli dene ki koshish ki thi, un par Janab-e-Bari Aziz-o-Hakim ne roomiyon ko ghalib kar diya aur un ke hathon un ki sakht zillat-o-ihanat hui. Aur abhi qayamat ke qareeb jab Aap (ﷺ) utrenge tab Dajjal ke sath un yahudiyon ki jo us ke lashkari honge qatl karenge. Aur Imam-e-Adil aur hakim-e-ba-insaf ban kar tashreef layenge, saleeb ko todenge, khanzeer ko qatl karenge aur jizya batil kar denge, bajuz Islam ke aur kuch qabool na farmayenge. Yeh hai Allah Ta'ala ki azeem-ush-shan madad aur yahi dastoor-e-qudrat hai jo pehle se hai aur ab tak jaari hai ke woh apne momin bandon ki dunyawi imdad bhi farmata hai aur un ke dushmanon se khud inteqam le kar un ki aankhein thandi karta hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal ne farmaya hai jo shakhs mere nabiyon se dushmani kare us ne mujhe larai ke liye talab kiya. Dusri hadith mein hai main apne doston ki taraf se badla zaroor le liya karta hoon jaise ke sher badla leta hai. Isi bina par is Malik-ul-Mulk ne qom-e-Nuh se, Aad se, Thamudiyon se, Ashab-ur-Rass se, qom-e-Loot se, Ahl-e-Madyan se aur un jaise un tamam logon se jinhon ne Allah ke rasoolon ko jhutlaya tha aur haq ka khilaf kiya tha badla liya. Ek ek ko chun chun kar tabah-o-barbad kiya aur jitne momin un mein the un sab ko bacha liya. Imam Suddi farmate hain jis qom mein Allah ke rasool A.S aaye ya iman dar bande unhein paigham-e-ilahi pahunchane ke liye khare hue aur us qom ne un nabiyon ki ya un mominon ki be-hurmati ki aur unhein mara peeta qatl kiya, zaroor bil-zaroor usi zamane mein azab-e-ilahi un par baras pare. Nabiyon ke qatl ke badle lene wale uth khare hue aur pani ki tarah un ke khoon se pyasi zameen ko sairab kiya.

Namumkin hai ke aise bandagan-e-khas ki imdad-o-ianat na ho aur un ke dushmanon se poora inteqam na liya gaya ho. Ashraf-ul-Anbiya Habibullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke halat-e-zindagi duniya aur duniya walon ke samne hain ke Allah ne Aap ko aur Aap ke Sahaba ko ghalba diya aur dushmanon ki tamam tar koshishon ko be-natija rakha. In tamam par Aap ko khula ghalba ata farmaya. Aap ke kalme ko buland-o-bala kiya, Aap ka deen duniya ke tamam adyan par chha gaya. Qaum ki zabardast mukhalifaton ke waqt apne Nabi ko Madine pahuncha diya aur Madine walon ko saccha jaan-nisar bana kar phir mushrikeen ka sara zor Badr ki ladai mein dha diya. Un ke kufr ke tamam wazni sutoon is ladai mein ukhed diye. Sardaran-e-mushrik ya to tukde tukde kar diye gaye ya Musalmanon ke hathon mein qaidi ban kar namuradi ke sath gardan jhukaye nazar aane lage. Qaid-o-band mein jakde hue zillat-o-ihanat ke sath Madine ki galiyon mein kisi ke hathon par aur kisi ke paon par dusre ki giraft thi. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ se farmaya ke fitna-e-Dajjal se Allah ki panah talab kiya karo. Woh Sami-o-Baseer hai. Lekin aayat ko Yahudiyon ke bare mein nazil shuda batana aur Dajjal ki badshahi aur us ke fitne se panah ka hukm, sab cheezein takalluf se pur hain. Mana ke yeh Tafseer Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai magar yeh qaul nudrat se khali nahin. Theek yahi hai ke aam hai. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'alam.

Insaan ki dobara paidaish ke dalail. Allah Ta'ala Qadir-e-Mutlaq farmata hai ke makhlooq ko woh Qayamat ke din naye sire se zaroor zinda karega, jabke usne aasman-o-zameen jaisi zabardast makhlooq ko paida kardiya toh insaan ka paida karna ya use bigad kar banana us par kya mushkil hai? Aur aayat mein irshad hai ke kya aisi baat aur itni wazeh haqeeqat bhi jhutlaye jaane ke qabil hai ke jis Allah ne zameen-o-aasman ko paida kardiya aur is itni badi cheez ki paidaish se na woh thaka na aajiz hua, us par murdon ka jalana kya mushkil hai? Aisi saaf daleel bhi jis ke saamne jhutlane ki cheez ho, us ki maloomat yaqeenan nauha karne ke qabil hain. Is ki jahalat mein kya shak hai? Jo aisi moti baat bhi na samajh sake? Ta'ajjub hai ke badi badi cheez toh tasleem ki jaye aur us se bahut chhoti cheez ko muhaal-e-mehaz maana jaye, andhe aur dekhne waale ka farq zahir hai, theek isi tarah muslim-o-mujrim ka farq hai. Aksar log kis qadar kam naseehat qabool karte hain, yaqeen mano ke Qayamat ka aana hatmi hai phir bhi is ki takzeeb karne aur ise bawar na karne se beshtar log baaz nahin aate. Ek Yamani Sheikh apni suni hui riwayat bayan karte hain, qareeb-e-Qayamat ke waqt logon par balayein baras padengi aur sooraj ki hararat sakht tez ho jayegi. Wallahu A'alam.

Dua ki hidayat aur qubooliyat ka wada. Allah Ta'ala Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ke is ehsan par qurban jayen ke woh hamain dua ki hidayat karta hai aur qubooliyat ka wada farmata hai. Imam Sufyan Thauri (R.H) apni duaon mein farmaya karte thay, "Aye woh Allah jise woh banda bahut hi pyara lagta hai jo bakasrat us se duayen kiya kare. Aur woh banda use sakht bura maloom hota hai jo us se dua na kare. Aye mere Rab! Yeh sifat toh sirf teri hi hai." Shair kehta hai: Allah yaghdabu in tarakta su'alahu, wa bani adama hina yus'alu yaghdabu. Ya'ni Allah Ta'ala ki shan yeh hai ke jab tu us se na mange toh woh na-khush hota hai aur insan ki yeh halat hai ke us se mango toh woh rooth jata hai. Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbar (R.A) farmate hain, is ummat ko teen cheezain aisi di gayi hain ke un se pehle ki kisi ummat ko nahin di gayin bajuz Nabi ke. Dekho har Nabi ko Allah ka farman yeh hua hai ke tu apni ummat par gawah hai. Lekin tamam logon par gawah Allah Ta'ala ne tumhain kiya hai. Agle nabiyon se kaha jata tha ke tujh par deen mein haraj nahin. Lekin is ummat se farmaya gaya ke tumhare deen mein tum par koi haraj nahin. Har Nabi se kaha jata tha ke mujhe pukaro main teri pukar qubool karunga, lekin is ummat ko farmaya gaya ke tum mujhe pukaro main tumhari pukar qubool farmaunga. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Abu Ya'la mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farmaya, "Char khaslatain hain jin mein se ek mere liye hai, ek tere liye, ek tere aur mere darmiyan aur ek tere darmiyan aur mere dusre bandon ke darmiyan. Jo khas mere liye hai woh toh yeh ke sirf meri hi ibadat kar aur mere sath kisi ko sharik na kar. Aur jo tera haq mujh par hai woh yeh ke tere har amal-e-khair ka bharpoor badla main tujhe dunga. Aur jo tere mere darmiyan hai woh yeh ke tu dua kar aur main qubool kiya karunga. Aur chauthi khaslat jo tere aur mere aur dusre bandon ke darmiyan hai woh yeh ke tu un ke liye woh chah jo apne liye pasand rakhta hai." Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke dua ain ibadat hai, phir aap ne yahi ayat tilawat farmayi. Yeh hadith sunan mein bhi hai, Imam Tirmidhi (R.H) ise Hasan Sahih kehte hain. Ibn-e-Hibban (R.H) aur Hakim (R.H) bhi ise apni Sahih mein laye hain. Musnad mein hai jo shakhs Allah se dua nahin karta Allah us par ghazab-nak hota hai. Hazrat Muhammad bin Maslama Ansari (R.A) ki maut ke baad un ki talwar ke darmiyan mein se ek parcha nikla jis mein tahrir tha ke tum apne Rab ki rehmaton ke mawaqe ko talash karte raho, bahut mumkin hai ke kisi aise waqt tum dua-e-khair karo ke us waqt Rab ki rehmat josh mein ho aur tumhain woh sa'adat mil jaye jis ke baad kabhi bhi hasrat-o-afsos na karna pade. Ayat mein ibadat se murad dua aur tauheed hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Qayamat ke din mutakabbir log chuntiyon ki shakal mein jama kiye jayenge. Choti se choti cheez bhi un ki upar hogi, unhain 'Bulas' nami jahannam ke jail khane mein dala jayega aur bhadakti hui sakht aag un ke saron par sholay maregi. Unhain jahannumiyon ka lahu, peep aur pakhana peshab pilaya jayega.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein ek buzurg farmate hain main mulk-e-Room mein kafiron ke hathon mein giraftar ho gaya tha. Ek din main ne suna ke hatif-e-ghaib ek pahar ki choti se ba-awaz-e-buland keh raha hai: "Aye Allah! Is par ta'ajjub hai jo tujhe pehchante hue tere siwa dusre ki zaat se ummeedein wabasta rakhta hai. Aye Allah! Is par bhi ta'ajjub hai jo tujhe pehchante hue apni hajatein dusron ke paas le jata hai." Phir zara thehar kar ek pur-zor awaz aur lagayi aur kaha: "Pura ta'ajjub us shakhs par hai jo tujhe pehchante hue dusre ki razamandi hasil karne ke liye woh kaam karta hai jin se tu naraz ho jaye." Yeh sun kar main ne buland awaz se pucha ke tu koi jinn hai ya insaan? Jawab aaya ke insaan hoon. Tu un kamon se apna dhyan hata le jo tujhe faida na dein. Aur un kamon mein mashghool ho ja jo tere faide ke hain.

Ahsanat-o-Inaamat ka tazkira. Allah Ta'ala ahsan bayan farmata hai ke usne raat ko sukoon-o-rahat ki cheez banayi. Aur din ko roshan chamkila taake har shakhs ko apne kaam-kaaj mein, safar mein, talab-e-ma'ash mein sahulat ho. Aur din bhar ka kasal aur thakaan raat ke sukoon-o-aaram se utar jaye. Makhlooq par Allah Ta'ala bade hi fazl-o-karam karne wala hai. Lekin aksar log Rabb ki ne'amaton ki nashukri karte hain. In cheezon ko paida karne wala aur yeh rahat-o-aaram ke saaman muhayya kar dene wala hi Allah Wahid hai. Jo tamam cheezon ka Khaliq hai. Uske siwa koi laiq-e-ibadat nahin, na uske siwa aur koi makhlooq ki parwarish karne wala hai. Phir tum kyun uske siwa dusron ki ibadat karte ho? Jo khud makhlooq hain. Kisi cheez ko unhon ne paida nahin kiya. Balkay jin buton ki tum parastish kar rahe ho woh toh khud tumhare apne hathon ke ghaday huye hain, un se pehle ke mushrikeen bhi isi tarah behkay aur be-daleel-o-hujjat ghair-ullah ki ibadat karne lagay. Khwahish-e-nafsani ko samne rakh kar Allah ke dalail ki takzeeb ki. Aur jahalat ko aagay rakh kar behakte bhatakte rahe. Allah Ta'ala ne zameen ko tumhare liye qarargah banaya. Ya'ni thehri hui aur farsh ki tarah bichhi hui ke is par tum apni zindagi guzaro, chalo phiro, aao jao. Paharon ko is par gaar kar usay thehra diya ke ab hil-jul nahin sakti. Usne aasman ko chhat banaya jo har tarah mehfooz hai. Isi ne tumhein behtareen suraton mein paida kiya. Har jod theek-thaak aur nazar-fareb banaya. Mauzoon qamat, munasib a'za, sadol badan, khubsurat chehra ata farmaya. Nafees aur behtar cheezein khane peene ko dein. Paida kiya, basaya, usne khilaya pilaya, usne pehnaya odhaya. Pas sahih ma'no mein Khaliq-o-Raziq wahi Rabb-ul-Aalameen hai. Jaise Surah Al-Baqarah mein farmaya... al-kh, ya'ni logo apne is Rabb ki ibadat karo jisne tumhein aur tum se aglon ko paida kiya taake tum bacho. Isi ne tumhare liye zameen ko farsh aur aasman ko chhat banaya aur aasman se barish nazil farma kar uski wajah se zameen se phal nikal kar tumhein roziyan dein, pas tum in baton ke jaanne ke bawajood Allah ke shareek auron ko na banao. Yahan bhi apni yeh sifatein bayan farma kar irshad farmaya ke yahi Allah tumhara Rabb hai. Aur saare jahan ka Rabb bhi wahi hai. Woh babarkat hai. Woh bulandi, pakeezgi, bartari aur buzurgi wala hai, woh azal se hai aur abad tak rahega. Woh zinda hai jis par kabhi maut nahin. Wahi Awwal-o-Aakhir, Zahir-o-Batin hai. Uska koi wasf kisi dusre mein nahin. Uska nazeer ya barabar koi nahin. Tumhein chahiye ke uski Tauheed ko maante huye us se duayein karte raho, aur uski ibadat mein mashghool raho. Tamam tar tareefon ka maalik Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen hi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) farmate hain ahl-e-ilm ki ek jamaat se manqool hai ke La Ilaha Illallah padhne wale ko saath hi Alhamdulillah Rabb-ul-Aalameen bhi padhna chahiye taake is aayat par amal ho jaye.

Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se bhi yeh marwi hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain jab tak "Fad'ullaha mukhlisina lahud-din" parhe toh "La ilaha illallah" keh liya kar aur uske sath hi "Alhamdulillah-e-Rabbil Aalameen" parh liya kar. Hazrat Abdullah bin Zubair R.A har namaz ke salam ke baad (La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shai'in qadeer) parha karte thay aur farmaya karte thay ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi in kalmaat ko har namaz ke baad parha karte thay. (Muslim, Abu Dawood, Nasai)

Kisi cheez ko unhon ne paida nahin kiya. Balkay jin buton ki tum parastish kar rahe ho woh toh khud tumhare apne hathon ke ghaday huye hain, un se pehle ke mushrikeen bhi isi tarah behkay aur be-daleel-o-hujjat ghair-ullah ki ibadat karne lagay. Khwahish-e-nafsani ko samne rakh kar Allah ke dalail ki takzeeb ki. Aur jahalat ko aagay rakh kar behakte bhatakte rahe. Allah Ta'ala ne zameen ko tumhare liye qarargah banaya. Ya'ni thehri hui aur farsh ki tarah bichhi hui ke is par tum apni zindagi guzaro, chalo phiro, aao jao. Paharon ko is par gaar kar usay thehra diya ke ab hil-jul nahin sakti. Usne aasman ko chhat banaya jo har tarah mehfooz hai. Isi ne tumhein behtareen suraton mein paida kiya. Har jod theek-thaak aur nazar-fareb banaya. Mauzoon qamat, munasib a'za, sadol badan, khubsurat chehra ata farmaya. Nafees aur behtar cheezein khane peene ko dein. Paida kiya, basaya, usne khilaya pilaya, usne pehnaya odhaya. Pas sahih ma'no mein Khaliq-o-Raziq wahi Rabb-ul-Aalameen hai. Jaise Surah Al-Baqarah mein farmaya... al-kh, ya'ni logo apne is Rabb ki ibadat karo jisne tumhein aur tum se aglon ko paida kiya taake tum bacho. Isi ne tumhare liye zameen ko farsh aur aasman ko chhat banaya aur aasman se barish nazil farma kar uski wajah se zameen se phal nikal kar tumhein roziyan dein, pas tum in baton ke jaanne ke bawajood Allah ke shareek auron ko na banao. Yahan bhi apni yeh sifatein bayan farma kar irshad farmaya ke yahi Allah tumhara Rabb hai. Aur saare jahan ka Rabb bhi wahi hai. Woh babarkat hai. Woh bulandi, pakeezgi, bartari aur buzurgi wala hai, woh azal se hai aur abad tak rahega. Woh zinda hai jis par kabhi maut nahin. Wahi Awwal-o-Aakhir, Zahir-o-Batin hai. Uska koi wasf kisi dusre mein nahin. Uska nazeer ya barabar koi nahin. Tumhein chahiye ke uski Tauheed ko maante huye us se duayein karte raho, aur uski ibadat mein mashghool raho. Tamam tar tareefon ka maalik Allah Rabb-ul-Aalameen hi hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) farmate hain ahl-e-ilm ki ek jamaat se manqool hai ke La Ilaha Illallah padhne wale ko saath hi Alhamdulillah Rabb-ul-Aalameen bhi padhna chahiye taake is aayat par amal ho jaye.

Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se bhi yeh marwi hai. Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mushrikeen ko dawat-e-tauheed. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke ae Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tum in mushrikon se keh do ke Allah Ta'ala apne siwa har kisi ki ibadat se apni makhlooq ko mana farma chuka hai. Us ke siwa aur koi mustahiq-e-ibadat nahin. Us ki bahut badi daleel us ke baad ki aayat hai, jis mein farmaya ke usi Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ne tumhein mitti se phir nutfay se phir khoon ki phatki se paida kiya. Usi ne tumhein maa ke pait se bachay ki soorat mein nikala. In tamam halaat ko wohi badalta raha phir usi ne bachpan se jawani tak tumhein pahunchaya. Wohi jawani ke baad budhapay tak le jaye ga yeh sab kaam usi ek ke hukm, taqdeer aur tadbeer se ho jate hain. Phir kis qadar namuradi hai ke us ke sath dusre ki ibadat ki jaye? Baaz is se pehle hi faut ho jate hain. Yani kachay pannay mein hi gir jate hain. Hamal saqit ho jata hai. Baaz bachpan mein, baaz jawani mein, baaz adher umar mein budhapay se pehle hi mar jate hain. Chunancha aur jagah Quran-e-Pak mein hai (وَنُقِرُّ فِي الْاَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَاۗءُ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى) (Surah Al-Hajj: 5) yani hum maa ke pait mein thehrate hain jab tak chahein. Yahan farman hai ke taake tum waqt-e-muqarrara tak pahunch jao. Aur tum socho samjho. Yani apni halaton ke is inqilab se tum imaan le aao ke is duniya ke baad bhi tumhein nayi zindagi mein ek roz khara hona hai, wohi zindagi dene wala aur maarne wala hai. Us ke siwa koi maut-o-zeest par qadir nahin. Us ke kisi hukm ko, kisi faislay ko, kisi taqarrur ko, kisi iraday ko koi todne wala nahin, jo woh chahta hai ho kar hi rehta hai aur jo woh na chahe namumkin hai ke woh ho jaye.

Kuffar ko azab-e-Jahannam aur tauq-o-salasil ki wa'eed. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya tumhein un logon par ta'ajjub nahin hota jo Allah ki baton ko jhutlate hain aur apne batil ke sahare haq se ulat-te hain? Tum nahin dekh rahe ke kis tarah un ki aqlein mari gayi hain? Aur bhalai ko chhor burai ko kaise buri tarah chimat gaye hain? Phir un bad-kirdar kuffar ko dara raha hai ke hidayat-o-bhalai ko jhoot janne wale kalam-e-Allah aur kalam-e-Rasool ke munkir apna anjam abhi dekh lenge. Jaise farmaya jhutlane walon ke liye halakat hai, jabke gardanon mein tauq aur zanjeerein pari hui hongi aur darogha-e-Jahannam ghasite ghasite phir rahe honge. Kabhi Hameem mein aur kabhi Jaheem mein. Garam kholte hue pani mein se ghasite jayenge. Aur aag-e-Jahannam mein jhulsaye jayenge. Jaise aur jagah hai. Yeh hai woh Jahannam jise gunahgar log jhoota jana karte the. Ab yeh is ke aur aag jaise garam pani ke darmiyan mare mare pareshan phira karenge. Aur ayaton mein un ka Zaqqum khana aur garam pani peena bayan farma kar farmaya (ثُمَّ اِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَا۟اِلَى الْجَحِيْمِ 68؀) (37. As-Saffat: 68) ke phir un ki bazgasht to Jahannam hi ki taraf hai. Surah Waqi'ah mein Ashab-e-Shumal ka zikr karte hue farmaya bayen hath wale kis qadar bure hain? Woh aag mein hain aur garam pani mein aur siyah dhuen ke saye mein jo na thanda hai na sood-mand, aage chal kar farmaya, ae behke hue jhutlane walo albatta Zaqqum ka darakht khaoge isi se apne pet bharoge. Phir is par jalta pani piyo ge aur is tarah jis tarah tuns wala oont peeta hai. Aaj insaf ke din un ki mehmani yahi hogi. Aur jagah farmaya hai (اِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّوْمِ 43؀ۙ) (44. Ad-Dukhan: 43), yani yaqeenan gunahgaron ka khana Zaqqum ka darakht hai jo misl pighle hue tambe ke hai jo peton mein kholta rehta hai. Jaise tez garam pani. Ise pakro aur dhakelte hue beechon beech Jahannam mein pahunchao phir is ke sar par tez garam jalte jalte pani ka azab bahao le chakh tu bara hi zi-izzat aur bari hi ta'zeem-o-takreem wala shakhs tha. Jis se tum shak shuba mein the. Maqsad yeh hai ke ek taraf se to woh yeh dukh seh rahe honge jin ka bayan hua aur dusri janib se unhein zaleel-o-khwar-o-roo siyah nahanjaar karne ke liye bator-e-istihza aur tamsukhur ke bator-e-dant aur dapt ke bator-e-haqarat aur zillat ke un se yeh kaha jayega jis ka zikr hua. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki ek ghareeb marfoo hadith mein hai ke ek janib se siyah abr uthega jise jahannami dekhenge aur un se pucha jayega ke tum kya chahte ho? Woh abr ko dekhte hue duniya ke andaz par kahenge ke yeh chahte hain ke yeh barse wahin is mein se tauq aur zanjeerein aur aag ke angare barasne lagenge jis ke shole unhein jalayenge jhulsayenge aur woh tauq-o-salasil un ke tauq-o-salasil ke sath izafa kar diye jayenge. Phir un se kaha jayega ke kyun ji duniya mein Allah Azzawajal ke siwa jin jin ko poojte rahe woh sab aaj kahan hain? Kyun woh tumhari madad ko nahin aaye?

Kyun tumhein yun kasm-porsi ki halat mein chhor diya? Toh woh jawab denge ke haan woh toh sab aaj na-paid ho gaye woh thay hi be-sood. Phir unhein kuch khayal aayega aur kahenge nahin nahin hum ne toh un ki ibadat kabhi nahin ki. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke jab un ke banaye kuch na banegi toh saaf inkar kar denge aur jhoot bol denge ke (Wallahi Rabbina Ma Kunna Mushrikeen) (Surah Al-An'am: 23). Allah hamein teri qasam hum mushrik na thay. Yeh kuffar isi tarah be-kari mein khoye rehte hain, un se farishtay kahenge yeh badla hai us ka jo duniya mein be-wajah gardan akraye akarte phirte thay. Takabbur-o-jabr par chust kamar rehte thay lo ab aajao Jahannam ke in darwazon mein dakhil ho jao ab hamesha yahin pe rehna tum jaise utrane walon ki hi yeh bad-manzil aur buri jaye-qarar hai. Jis qadar takabbur kiye thay utne hi zaleel-o-khwar aaj banoge. Jitne hi buland gaye thay utne hi giroge. Wallahu A'lam.

Woh abr ko dekhte hue duniya ke andaz par kahenge ke yeh chahte hain ke yeh barse wahin is mein se tauq aur zanjeerein aur aag ke angare barasne lagenge jis ke shole unhein jalayenge jhulsayenge aur woh tauq-o-salasil un ke tauq-o-salasil ke sath izafa kar diye jayenge. Phir un se kaha jayega ke kyun ji duniya mein Allah Azzawajal ke siwa jin jin ko poojte rahe woh sab aaj kahan hain? Kyun woh tumhari madad ko nahin aaye?

Kyun tumhein yun kasm-porsi ki halat mein chhor diya? Toh woh jawab denge ke haan woh toh sab aaj na-paid ho gaye woh thay hi be-sood. Phir unhein kuch khayal aayega aur kahenge nahin nahin hum ne toh un ki ibadat kabhi nahin ki. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke jab un ke banaye kuch na banegi toh saaf inkar kar denge aur jhoot bol denge ke (Wallahi Rabbina Ma Kunna Mushrikeen) (Surah Al-An'am: 23). Allah hamein teri qasam hum mushrik na thay. Yeh kuffar isi tarah be-kari mein khoye rehte hain, un se farishtay kahenge yeh badla hai us ka jo duniya mein be-wajah gardan akraye akarte phirte thay. Takabbur-o-jabr par chust kamar rehte thay lo ab aajao Jahannam ke in darwazon mein dakhil ho jao ab hamesha yahin pe rehna tum jaise utrane walon ki hi yeh bad-manzil aur buri jaye-qarar hai. Jis qadar takabbur kiye thay utne hi zaleel-o-khwar aaj banoge. Jitne hi buland gaye thay utne hi giroge. Wallahu A'lam.

Kuffar ko azab-e-Jahannam aur tauq-o-salasil ki wa'eed. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke ae Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kya tumhein un logon par ta'ajjub nahin hota jo Allah ki baton ko jhutlate hain aur apne batil ke sahare haq se ulat-te hain? Tum nahin dekh rahe ke kis tarah un ki aqlein mari gayi hain? Aur bhalai ko chhor burai ko kaise buri tarah chimat gaye hain? Phir un bad-kirdar kuffar ko dara raha hai ke hidayat-o-bhalai ko jhoot janne wale kalam-e-Allah aur kalam-e-Rasool ke munkir apna anjam abhi dekh lenge. Kabhi Hameem mein aur kabhi Jaheem mein. Garam kholte hue pani mein se ghasite jayenge. Aur aag-e-Jahannam mein jhulsaye jayenge. Jaise aur jagah hai. Yeh hai woh Jahannam jise gunahgar log jhoota jana karte the. Ab yeh is ke aur aag jaise garam pani ke darmiyan mare mare pareshan phira karenge. Aur ayaton mein un ka Zaqqum khana aur garam pani peena bayan farma kar farmaya (ثُمَّ اِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَا۟اِلَى الْجَحِيْمِ 68؀) (37. As-Saffat: 68) ke phir un ki bazgasht to Jahannam hi ki taraf hai. Surah Waqi'ah mein Ashab-e-Shumal ka zikr karte hue farmaya bayen hath wale kis qadar bure hain? Woh aag mein hain aur garam pani mein aur siyah dhuen ke saye mein jo na thanda hai na sood-mand, aage chal kar farmaya, ae behke hue jhutlane walo albatta Zaqqum ka darakht khaoge isi se apne pet bharoge. Phir is par jalta pani piyo ge aur is tarah jis tarah tuns wala oont peeta hai. Aaj insaf ke din un ki mehmani yahi hogi. Aur jagah farmaya hai (اِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّوْمِ 43؀ۙ) (44. Ad-Dukhan: 43), yani yaqeenan gunahgaron ka khana Zaqqum ka darakht hai jo misl pighle hue tambe ke hai jo peton mein kholta rehta hai. Jaise tez garam pani. Ise pakro aur dhakelte hue beechon beech Jahannam mein pahunchao phir is ke sar par tez garam jalte jalte pani ka azab bahao le chakh tu bara hi zi-izzat aur bari hi ta'zeem-o-takreem wala shakhs tha. Allah ke wade qatan haq hain. Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sabr ka hukum deta hai ke jo teri nahin maante tujhe jhoota kehte hain to un ki ezaon par sabr-o-bardasht kar. In sab par fath-o-nusrat tujhe mile gi. Anjam-e-kaar har tarah tere hi haq mein behtar rahe ga. Tu aur tere yeh manne wale hi tamam duniya par ghalib ho kar rahen ge, aur aakhirat to sirf tumhari hi hai, pas ya to hum apne wade ki baaz cheezein tujhe teri zindagi mein dikha den ge, aur yehi hua bhi, Badr wale din kuffar ka dhar aur sar tod diya gaya, Quraishiyon ke bade bade sardar mare gaye. Bil-aakhir Makkah fath hua aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) duniya se rukhsat na hue jab tak ke tamam jazeera-e-Arab Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke zer-e-nageen na ho gaya. Aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke dushman Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne zaleel-o-khwar na hue aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aankhein Rabb ne thandi na kar dein, ya agar hum tujhe faut hi kar lein to bhi un ka lautna to hamari hi taraf hai hum unhein aakhirat ke dard-naak sakht azaab mein mubtala karen ge, phir mazeed tasalli ke taur par farma raha hai ke tujh se pehle bhi hum bahut se Rasool bhej chuke hain jin mein se baaz ke halaat hum ne tere samne bayan kar diye hain. Aur baaz ke qisse hum ne bayan bhi nahin kiye jaise Surah Nisa mein bhi farmaya gaya hai. Pas jin ke qisse mazkoora hain dekh lo ke qaum se un ki kaisi kuch nimti. Aur baaz ke waqiyat hum ne bayan nahin kiye woh ba-nisbat un ke bahut zyada hain. Jaise ke hum ne Surah Nisa ki tafseer ke mauqa par bayan kar diya hai. Wallahul Hamdu wal Minnah. Phir farmaya yeh namumkin hai ke koi Rasool apni marzi se maujizaat aur khawariq-e-aadaat dikhaye haan Allah Azza-wa-Jal ke hukum ke baad kyunke Rasool ke qabze mein koi cheez nahin. Haan jab Allah ka azaab aa jata hai phir takzeeb-o-tardeed karne wale kuffar bach nahin sakte. Momin najaat pa lete hain aur baatil parast baatil kaar tabah ho jate hain.

Har makhlooq Khaliq-e-Kainat par daleel hai. In'aam ya'ni oont, gaye, bakri Allah Ta'ala ne insaan ke tarah-tarah ke nafa' ke liye paida kiye hain, sawariyon ke kaam aate hain, khaye jate hain. Oont sawari ka kaam bhi de, khaya bhi jaye, doodh bhi de, bojh bhi dhoye aur door daraz ke safar ba-aasani se kara diye. Gaye ka gosht khane ke kaam bhi aaye, doodh bhi de, hal bhi jote, bakri ka gosht bhi khaya jaye aur doodh bhi piya jaye. Phir in ke sab ke baal beesiyon kaamon mein aayen. Jaise ke Surah An'am, Surah Nahl waghera mein bayan ho chuka hai. Yahan bhi yeh munafe' bator-e-in'aam ginwaye ja rahe hain, duniya jahan mein aur is ke goshe-goshe mein aur kainat ke zarre-zarre mein aur khud tumhari jaanon mein us Allah ki nishaniyan majood hain. Sach toh yeh hai ke us ki anginat nishaniyon mein se ek ka bhi koi shakhs sahih ma'ni mein inkari nahin ho sakta, yeh aur baat hai ke zid aur akar se kaam le aur aankhon par thikri rakh le.

Nuzool-e-Azab ke waqt ka iman be-faida hai. Allah Ta'ala in aglay logon ko khabar de raha hai jo Rasoolon ko us se pehlay jhutla chukay hain. Saath hi batata hai ke us ka natija kya kuch unhon ne bhugta? Bawajood-e-ke woh qawi thay, zyada thay, zameen mein nishanat, imaratain waghera bhi zyada rakhnay walay thay aur baray maldar thay. Lekin koi cheez un ke kaam na aayi, kisi ne Allah ke azab ko na dafa kiya, na kam kiya, na tala, na hataya. Yeh thay hi gharat kiye janay ke qabil kyunke jab un ke paas Allah ke qasid saaf saaf daleelain, roshan hujjatain, khulay mojzat, pakeeza taleemat le kar aaye to unhon ne aankh bhar kar dekha tak nahin, apnay paas ke uloom par maghroor ho gaye aur Rasoolon ki taleem ki haqarat karnay lagay, kehnay lagay hum hi zyada aalim hain, hisab kitab, azab-o-sawab koi cheez nahin. Apni jahalat ko ilm samajh bethay. Phir to Allah ka woh azab aaya ke un ke banaye kuch na bani aur jisay jhutlatay thay, jis par naak bhon charhatay thay, jisay mazaq mein uratay thay, usi ne unhain tehas nehas kar diya, phir kas-bal nikal dala, teh-o-bala kar diya, rooi ki tarah dhun diya aur bhoosi ki tarah ura diya. Allah ke azabon ko aata hua balkay aaya hua dekh kar iman ka iqrar kiya aur tauheed tasleem bhi kar li, aur ghair-e-Allah Jalla Shanuhu se saaf inkar bhi kiya, lekin us waqt ki na tauba qabool, na iman qabool, na islam musallam. Firaun ne bhi gharq hotay huay kaha tha ke mera us Allah Jalla Shanuhu par iman hai jis par Bani Israel ka iman hai, main us ke siwa kisi ko laiq-e-ibadat nahin manta, main islam qabool karta hoon. Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki taraf se jawab milta hai ke ab iman lana be-sood hai. Bohat nafarmaniyan aur shar-angeziyan kar chukay ho. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne bhi is sarkash ke liye yahi bad-dua ki thi ke aye Allah Jalla Shanuhu! Aal-e-Firaun ke dilon ko is qadar sakht kar de ke azab-e-aleem dekh lenay tak unhain iman naseeb na ho. Pas yahan bhi farman-e-Bari hai ke azabon ka muaina karnay par iman ki qabooliyat ne unhain koi faida na pohanchaya. Yeh Allah ka hukm-e-aam hai. Jo bhi azabon ko dekh kar tauba karay us ki tauba na-maqbool hai. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai, ghargharay se pehlay tak ki tauba qabool hai. Jab dam seenay mein atka, rooh halqoom tak pohanch gayi, farishton ko dekh liya, ab koi tauba nahin. Isi liye aakhir mein irshad farmaya ke kuffar tootay aur ghaatay mein hi hain.

Jab dam seenay mein atka, rooh halqoom tak pohanch gayi, farishton ko dekh liya, ab koi tauba nahin. Isi liye aakhir mein irshad farmaya ke kuffar tootay aur ghaatay mein hi hain.

Nuzool-e-Azab ke waqt ka iman be-faida hai. Allah Ta'ala in aglay logon ko khabar de raha hai jo Rasoolon ko us se pehlay jhutla chukay hain. Saath hi batata hai ke us ka natija kya kuch unhon ne bhugta? Bawajood-e-ke woh qawi thay, zyada thay, zameen mein nishanat, imaratain waghera bhi zyada rakhnay walay thay aur baray maldar thay. Lekin koi cheez un ke kaam na aayi, kisi ne Allah ke azab ko na dafa kiya, na kam kiya, na tala, na hataya. Yeh thay hi gharat kiye janay ke qabil kyunke jab un ke paas Allah ke qasid saaf saaf daleelain, roshan hujjatain, khulay mojzat, pakeeza taleemat le kar aaye to unhon ne aankh bhar kar dekha tak nahin, apnay paas ke uloom par maghroor ho gaye aur Rasoolon ki taleem ki haqarat karnay lagay, kehnay lagay hum hi zyada aalim hain, hisab kitab, azab-o-sawab koi cheez nahin. Apni jahalat ko ilm samajh bethay. Phir to Allah ka woh azab aaya ke un ke banaye kuch na bani aur jisay jhutlatay thay, jis par naak bhon charhatay thay, jisay mazaq mein uratay thay, usi ne unhain tehas nehas kar diya, phir kas-bal nikal dala, teh-o-bala kar diya, rooi ki tarah dhun diya aur bhoosi ki tarah ura diya. Allah ke azabon ko aata hua balkay aaya hua dekh kar iman ka iqrar kiya aur tauheed tasleem bhi kar li, aur ghair-e-Allah Jalla Shanuhu se saaf inkar bhi kiya, lekin us waqt ki na tauba qabool, na iman qabool, na islam musallam. Firaun ne bhi gharq hotay huay kaha tha ke mera us Allah Jalla Shanuhu par iman hai jis par Bani Israel ka iman hai, main us ke siwa kisi ko laiq-e-ibadat nahin manta, main islam qabool karta hoon. Allah Jalla Shanuhu ki taraf se jawab milta hai ke ab iman lana be-sood hai. Bohat nafarmaniyan aur shar-angeziyan kar chukay ho. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne bhi is sarkash ke liye yahi bad-dua ki thi ke aye Allah Jalla Shanuhu! Aal-e-Firaun ke dilon ko is qadar sakht kar de ke azab-e-aleem dekh lenay tak unhain iman naseeb na ho.
